_desc_ko:
빈도 시간당 한 번

요구조건 신기루 용의 다음 행동이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{투명화} 시전이어야 함

효과 용이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{투명}해지면서, 그들은 원래 위치에 1분간 지속되는 자신의 환영 복제를 남긴다. 복제가 환영임을 알아챈 생물이라도 신기루 용이 투명하다는 것을 반드시 아는 것은 아니며, 용의 투명한 형태를 볼 수 있는 생물이라도 복제가 환영이라는 것을 반드시 아는 것은 아니다. 신기루 용이 보폭이나 비행을 하면, 그들은 자유 행동으로 환영을 유지하여 그것이 최대 60피트까지 보폭이나 비행을 하게 하거나, 환영을 통해 말하거나, 용의 주문 공격 수정치를 명중 굴림에 사용하여 발톱 타격을 하게 할 수 있다. 이 타격은 용의 가장 높은 주문 랭크로 강화된 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{환영 생물} 주문과 동일한 양과 유형의 피해를 준다. 신기루 용은 환영을 해제할 수 있다.

name: (Vampire, Strigoi Progenitor) Create Servitor

description.value:
If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Domain of Dusk or Drink Essence, the strigoi can turn this victim into a vampire servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights.

A victim that's 8th level or higher becomes a strigoi servant, while a lower-level victim instead becomes a moroi vampire.

A vampiric servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if a vampire controls too many vampiric servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than the vampire that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a @Check[will|against:will] saving throw against the vampire's Will DC.

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path #215: To Blot Out the Sun

_desc_en:
If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Domain of Dusk or Drink Essence, the strigoi can turn this victim into a vampire servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights.

A victim that's 8th level or higher becomes a strigoi servant, while a lower-level victim instead becomes a moroi vampire.

A vampiric servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if a vampire controls too many vampiric servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than the vampire that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a @Check[will|against:will] saving throw against the vampire's Will DC.
_desc_ko:
어떤 생물이 황혼의 영역 또는 정수 흡입에 의해 HP 0으로 감소한 후 사망하면, 스트리고이는 자신의 피 일부를 희생자에게 나눠주고 희생자를 흙에 3일 밤 동안 묻어 이 희생자를 뱀파이어 하수인으로 만들 수 있다.

8레벨 이상인 희생자는 스트리고이 하인이 되고, 그보다 낮은 레벨의 희생자는 대신 모로이 뱀파이어가 된다.

뱀파이어 하수인은 자신의 창조주에게 복종하도록 강요받지만, 뱀파이어가 한 번에 너무 많은 뱀파이어 하수인을 지배하거나(GM이 결정), 하수인이 자신을 창조한 뱀파이어보다 높은 레벨이라면, 의지가 강한 하수인은 뱀파이어의 의지 DC에 대한 @Check[will|against:will] 내성 굴림에 성공하여 스스로를 해방시킬 수 있다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Weakness

description.value: The strain of being controlled wears on the nosferatu thrall's mind, giving them weakness 10 to mental damage.

_desc_en: The strain of being controlled wears on the nosferatu thrall's mind, giving them weakness 10 to mental damage.
_desc_ko: 지배당하는 부담이 노스페라투 노예의 정신을 마모시켜, 그들에게 정신 피해에 대한 약점 10을 부여한다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Command Thrall

description.value:
Requirements One of the nosferatu's thralls is present and can hear the nosferatu

Effect The nosferatu gives a single command to one of their thralls, which the thrall follows to the best of its ability during its next turn.

_desc_en:
Requirements One of the nosferatu's thralls is present and can hear the nosferatu

Effect The nosferatu gives a single command to one of their thralls, which the thrall follows to the best of its ability during its next turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 노스페라투의 노예 중 하나가 존재하며 노스페라투의 말을 들을 수 있어야 함

효과 노스페라투가 자신의 노예 중 하나에게 단일 명령을 내리며, 노예는 다음 턴 동안 최선을 다해 이를 따른다.

name: (Adamantine Dragon) Scything Wings

description.value:
Requirements The dragon has their Speed increased by Abandon Armor

Effect The dragon Flies and makes up to two claw attacks against different creatures along their flight.

_desc_en:
Requirements The dragon has their Speed increased by Abandon Armor

Effect The dragon Flies and makes up to two claw attacks against different creatures along their flight.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 용이 갑옷 벗기로 이동속도가 증가한 상태여야 함

효과 용이 비행하며 비행 경로를 따라 서로 다른 생물에게 최대 두 번의 발톱 공격을 한다.

name: (Martial Artist, Dirty Fighting) Illegal Bite

description.value: The martial artist makes an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against a target's Fortitude DC to bite them in a vulnerable area. On a success, the martial artist deals @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage (or double on a critical success).

_desc_en: The martial artist makes an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against a target's Fortitude DC to bite them in a vulnerable area. On a success, the martial artist deals @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage (or double on a critical success).
_desc_ko: 무술가가 목표의 건강 DC에 대해 @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] 판정을 하여 그들의 취약한 부위를 문다. 성공 시, 무술가는 @Damage[2d6[piercing]] 피해(대성공 시 두 배)를 준다.

name: (Failed Prophet) Wealthsense

description.value: The failed prophet can detect concentrations of coinage and other valuables as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet. The failed prophet detects any creature carrying coins and treasure totaling at least the average cost of a consumable item of the failed prophet's level.

_desc_en: The failed prophet can detect concentrations of coinage and other valuables as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet. The failed prophet detects any creature carrying coins and treasure totaling at least the average cost of a consumable item of the failed prophet's level.
_desc_ko: 실패한 예언자는 사거리 60피트의 부정확 감각으로 화폐 및 기타 귀중품의 집중을 탐지할 수 있다. 실패한 예언자는 실패한 예언자 레벨의 소모품 아이템 평균 가격 이상에 해당하는 동전과 보물을 지닌 생물을 탐지한다.

name: (Nemesis) Fast Healing

description.value: Nemesis gains fast healing 40; reduce Nemesis' Hit Points to 180.

_desc_en: Nemesis gains fast healing 40; reduce Nemesis' Hit Points to 180.
_desc_ko: 네메시스가 빠른 치유 40을 얻는다; 네메시스의 히트 포인트를 180으로 감소시킨다.

name: (Skeleton) Grave Eruption

description.value:
Requirements The skeleton is undetected and buried in dirt, gravel, or other loose material

Effect The skeleton erupts from the ground, Stands, and makes a melee Strike. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit).

_desc_en:
Requirements The skeleton is undetected and buried in dirt, gravel, or other loose material

Effect The skeleton erupts from the ground, Stands, and makes a melee Strike. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical hit).
_desc_ko:
요구조건 스켈레톤이 미탐지 상태이며 흙, 자갈, 또는 기타 헐거운 물질에 묻혀 있어야 함

효과 스켈레톤이 땅에서 솟아올라 일어나서 근접 타격을 한다. 목표는 이 타격에 대해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태다. 타격이 명중하면, 목표는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 1}(대성공 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2})이 된다.

name: (Vampire, Vrykolakas) Drink Blood

description.value:
Requirements The vrykolakas' last action was a successful fangs Strike

Effect The vrykolakas sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} if a vrykolakas master uses this action), and the vrykolakas regains HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire, but it increases the creature's drained condition value by 1. A vrykolakas can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirements The vrykolakas' last action was a successful fangs Strike

Effect The vrykolakas sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} if a vrykolakas master uses this action), and the vrykolakas regains HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire, but it increases the creature's drained condition value by 1. A vrykolakas can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 브리콜라카스의 마지막 행동이 성공한 송곳니 타격이었어야 함

효과 브리콜라카스가 그 생물에게 송곳니를 박아 넣어 피를 마신다. 이는 그 생물의 건강 DC에 대한 @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] 판정을 필요로 한다. 성공 시, 그 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 1}(브리콜라카스 우두머리가 이 행동을 사용하면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 2})이 되고, 브리콜라카스는 최대 HP의 10%에 해당하는 HP를 회복하며, 초과분은 임시 히트 포인트로 얻는다. 이미 생명력이 고갈된 생물로부터 피를 마시는 것은 뱀파이어에게 HP를 회복시키지 않지만, 그 생물의 생명력 고갈 상태 값을 1 증가시킨다. 브리콜라카스는 또한 용기에 담긴 피를 양분으로 섭취할 수 있으나, 그렇게 해서는 HP를 얻지 못한다.

목표 생물의 생명력 고갈 상태 값은 주당 1씩 감소한다. 성공한 @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:수혈] 판정과 충분한 피 또는 헌혈자를 필요로 하는 수혈은 10분 후 생명력 고갈 값을 1 감소시킨다.

name: (Empyreal Dragon) Sacrificial Shield

description.value:
Trigger An ally within 60 feet of the dragon would take damage

Effect The dragon's halo imposes itself in front of the creature like a shield, transferring the damage to the dragon. If the damage is void, the dragon gains resistance to that damage equal to half its level.

_desc_en:
Trigger An ally within 60 feet of the dragon would take damage

Effect The dragon's halo imposes itself in front of the creature like a shield, transferring the damage to the dragon. If the damage is void, the dragon gains resistance to that damage equal to half its level.
_desc_ko:
발동 용으로부터 60피트 이내의 아군이 피해를 받으려 할 때

효과 용의 후광이 그 생물 앞에 방패처럼 자리 잡아, 피해를 용에게 전이시킨다. 그 피해가 공허 피해라면, 용은 그 피해에 대해 자신 레벨의 절반과 동일한 저항을 얻는다.

name: (Fortune Dragon) Shield of Fortune

description.value: The dragon adjusts the treasure around their body to function as a kind of shield. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of their next turn and can use the Shield Block reaction. The shield has Hardness, Hit Points, and BT of a sturdy shield of the dragon's level. When it is broken, it triggers the effect of the dragon's Share the Wealth ability.

_desc_en: The dragon adjusts the treasure around their body to function as a kind of shield. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of their next turn and can use the Shield Block reaction. The shield has Hardness, Hit Points, and BT of a sturdy shield of the dragon's level. When it is broken, it triggers the effect of the dragon's Share the Wealth ability.
_desc_ko: 용이 자신의 몸 주위의 보물을 조정하여 일종의 방패로 기능하게 한다. 그들은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 AC에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻으며 방패 막기 반응을 사용할 수 있다. 이 방패는 용 레벨의 견고한 방패의 견고도, 히트 포인트, BT를 가진다. 방패가 파손되면, 용의 부의 분배 능력 효과가 발동한다.

name: (Resurrection Dragon) Deathless Servant

description.value: When a resurrection dragon performs the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} ritual, they can create any common undead and don't require secondary casters. If the dragon creates a mindless undead creature whose level is at least 2 lower than themself, it automatically becomes the dragon's minion—a deathless servant. This minion can't be destroyed unless the dragon is slain; if reduced to 0 Hit Points, such a minion returns to full Hit Points [[/gmr 1d6 #days]]{1d6 days} later. A resurrection dragon can have only one deathless servant at a time.

_desc_en: When a resurrection dragon performs the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} ritual, they can create any common undead and don't require secondary casters. If the dragon creates a mindless undead creature whose level is at least 2 lower than themself, it automatically becomes the dragon's minion—a deathless servant. This minion can't be destroyed unless the dragon is slain; if reduced to 0 Hit Points, such a minion returns to full Hit Points [[/gmr 1d6 #days]]{1d6 days} later. A resurrection dragon can have only one deathless servant at a time.
_desc_ko: 부활 용이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{언데드 창조} 의식을 수행할 때, 그들은 어떤 일반 언데드든 창조할 수 있으며 보조 시전자를 필요로 하지 않는다. 용이 자신보다 레벨이 최소 2 낮은 정신 없는 언데드 생물을 창조하면, 그것은 자동으로 용의 부하—불사의 하인—가 된다. 이 부하는 용이 처치되지 않는 한 파괴될 수 없다; 히트 포인트 0으로 감소하면, 그러한 부하는 [[/gmr 1d6 #days]]{1d6일} 후에 완전한 히트 포인트로 돌아온다. 부활 용은 한 번에 불사의 하인을 하나만 가질 수 있다.

name: (Skeleton) Blaze

description.value:
The skeleton is wreathed with fire, which doesn't consume its bones or gear.

The skeleton gains immunity to fire and weakness 5 to cold, loses its resistance to cold, and its Strikes deal additional persistent fire damage equal to half the skeleton's level (minimum 1 damage).

_desc_en:
The skeleton is wreathed with fire, which doesn't consume its bones or gear.

The skeleton gains immunity to fire and weakness 5 to cold, loses its resistance to cold, and its Strikes deal additional persistent fire damage equal to half the skeleton's level (minimum 1 damage).
_desc_ko:
스켈레톤이 화염에 휩싸여 있으나, 이 화염은 자신의 뼈나 장비를 태우지 않는다.

스켈레톤은 화염에 대한 면역과 냉기에 대한 약점 5를 얻고, 냉기에 대한 저항을 잃으며, 그 타격은 스켈레톤 레벨의 절반과 동일한 추가 지속 화염 피해(최소 1 피해)를 준다.

name: (Adamantine Dragon) Magnetic Roar

description.value: With a mighty roar, the dragon attracts metal in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60]. Any unattended metal object of 1 Bulk or less flies to the dragon and sticks to their hide, granting a +2 item bonus to AC for 1 minute. Any creature holding a metal object of 1 Bulk or less must attempt at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Avalanche Breath DC or have their item pulled to the dragon and stuck for 1 round. A creature wearing metal armor instead must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save against the DC + 2 or be pulled, taking @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage for every 10 feet it was moved, and become magnetically stuck to the dragon for 1 round. An object or creature can be unstuck with an Interact action.

_desc_en: With a mighty roar, the dragon attracts metal in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60]. Any unattended metal object of 1 Bulk or less flies to the dragon and sticks to their hide, granting a +2 item bonus to AC for 1 minute. Any creature holding a metal object of 1 Bulk or less must attempt at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Avalanche Breath DC or have their item pulled to the dragon and stuck for 1 round. A creature wearing metal armor instead must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save against the DC + 2 or be pulled, taking @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage for every 10 feet it was moved, and become magnetically stuck to the dragon for 1 round. An object or creature can be unstuck with an Interact action.
_desc_ko: 강력한 포효와 함께, 용이 @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] 안의 금속을 끌어당긴다. 부피 1 이하의 방치된 금속 물체는 용에게 날아가 그들의 가죽에 달라붙어, 1분간 AC에 +2 아이템 보너스를 부여한다. 부피 1 이하의 금속 물체를 들고 있는 생물은 용의 산사태 숨결 DC와 동일한 DC의 @Check[fortitude|dc:] 내성을 시도해야 하며, 실패 시 그 아이템이 용에게 끌려가 1라운드간 달라붙는다. 금속 갑옷을 착용한 생물은 대신 DC + 2에 대한 @Check[fortitude|dc:] 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 끌려가면서 이동한 거리 10피트당 @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] 피해를 받고 1라운드간 용에게 자기적으로 달라붙는다. 물체나 생물은 상호작용 행동으로 떼어낼 수 있다.

name: (Secret Society) Connected

description.value: The secret society member has numerous connections, especially within the broad band of social class from which the society recruits, but stretching further through friendships, extortion, and other forms of influence. Whenever encountering a character from a settlement where the secret society has influence, the secret society member can attempt a Society check with an easy DC for the level of the encountered character if that character is a member of the demographic from which the secret society recruits, and a DC of hard or higher for other characters. On a success, the secret society member has a connection with that character they can use to ingratiate themself or push that character into acting the way the secret society member wants. This grants the secret society member a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act make-an-impression]], [[/act coerce]], [[/act demoralize]], or Request. On a critical success, the connection is especially strong or powerful and might even include a direct connection with the secret society. The circumstance bonus increases to +4. A secret society member can use this ability on a PC, though beyond Demoralize, the connection is more of a roleplay note informing their interactions with the PC.

_desc_en: The secret society member has numerous connections, especially within the broad band of social class from which the society recruits, but stretching further through friendships, extortion, and other forms of influence. Whenever encountering a character from a settlement where the secret society has influence, the secret society member can attempt a Society check with an easy DC for the level of the encountered character if that character is a member of the demographic from which the secret society recruits, and a DC of hard or higher for other characters. On a success, the secret society member has a connection with that character they can use to ingratiate themself or push that character into acting the way the secret society member wants. This grants the secret society member a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act make-an-impression]], [[/act coerce]], [[/act demoralize]], or Request. On a critical success, the connection is especially strong or powerful and might even include a direct connection with the secret society. The circumstance bonus increases to +4. A secret society member can use this ability on a PC, though beyond Demoralize, the connection is more of a roleplay note informing their interactions with the PC.
_desc_ko: 비밀 결사 구성원은 수많은 인맥을 가지고 있는데, 특히 결사가 인원을 모집하는 넓은 사회 계층 내에서 그러하며, 우정, 협박, 기타 영향력의 형태를 통해 더 멀리까지 뻗어 있다. 비밀 결사가 영향력을 지닌 정착지 출신의 캐릭터를 마주칠 때마다, 비밀 결사 구성원은 그 마주친 캐릭터가 비밀 결사가 모집하는 인구층의 구성원이라면 그 캐릭터 레벨에 대한 쉬움 DC로, 다른 캐릭터라면 어려움 이상의 DC로 사회 판정을 시도할 수 있다. 성공 시, 비밀 결사 구성원은 그 캐릭터와 인맥을 갖게 되어 그것을 이용해 자신을 환심 사게 하거나 그 캐릭터를 비밀 결사 구성원이 원하는 방식으로 행동하도록 밀어붙일 수 있다. 이는 비밀 결사 구성원에게 [[/act make-an-impression]], [[/act coerce]], [[/act demoralize]], 또는 요청에 +2 상황 보너스를 부여한다. 대성공 시, 그 인맥은 특히 강하거나 강력하며, 심지어 비밀 결사와의 직접적인 연결을 포함할 수도 있다. 상황 보너스가 +4로 증가한다. 비밀 결사 구성원은 PC에게 이 능력을 사용할 수 있으나, 사기 꺾기를 제외하면, 그 인맥은 PC와의 상호작용을 알려주는 롤플레이 참고 사항에 가깝다.

name: (Ulgrem-Axaan) Ichor Coating

description.value: Beneath the plates of bone and ice on Ulgrem-Axaan flow the viscous remains of its vital fluids. Creatures coming into physical contact with this fluid must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|name:Ichor Coating] save or become infected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.N7UV5CZXtcoxDxCF]{Ghoul Fever}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en: Beneath the plates of bone and ice on Ulgrem-Axaan flow the viscous remains of its vital fluids. Creatures coming into physical contact with this fluid must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|name:Ichor Coating] save or become infected with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.N7UV5CZXtcoxDxCF]{Ghoul Fever}.
_desc_ko: 울그렘-아자안의 뼈와 얼음 판 아래로 그 생명 유동체의 점성 잔여물이 흐른다. 이 유동체와 물리적으로 접촉하는 생물은 @Check[fortitude|dc:22|name:이코르 도포] 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.N7UV5CZXtcoxDxCF]{구울 열병}에 감염된다.

name: (Omen Dragon) Link Fates

description.value: The omen dragon creates a bond between two creatures within 60 feet, entwining their destinies for 1 round. The first time during this duration that one of the creatures takes damage, the other takes an equal amount of mental damage, with a @Check[will|basic|dc:] save (DC equal to the dragon's Destiny Breath DC).

_desc_en: The omen dragon creates a bond between two creatures within 60 feet, entwining their destinies for 1 round. The first time during this duration that one of the creatures takes damage, the other takes an equal amount of mental damage, with a @Check[will|basic|dc:] save (DC equal to the dragon's Destiny Breath DC).
_desc_ko: 전조 용이 60피트 이내의 두 생물 사이에 유대를 만들어, 1라운드간 그들의 운명을 얽는다. 이 지속시간 동안 두 생물 중 하나가 처음으로 피해를 받으면, 다른 하나는 @Check[will|basic|dc:] 내성(용의 운명 숨결 DC와 동일한 DC)과 함께 동일한 양의 정신 피해를 받는다.

name: (Mythic) Mythic Weakness (Frailty)

description.value: A mythic ambusher relies on stealth and subterfuge. It can't gain mythic immunity to Strikes or mythic resistance.

_desc_en: A mythic ambusher relies on stealth and subterfuge. It can't gain mythic immunity to Strikes or mythic resistance.
_desc_ko: 신화적 매복자는 은신과 술책에 의존한다. 그것은 타격에 대한 신화적 면역이나 신화적 저항을 얻을 수 없다.

name: (Sporeborn) Contagious Spores

description.value: The sporeborn continues to infect creatures with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.EosAqVmnYlxMEGdT]{Sporeborn Infestation}, creating more of its own kind.

_desc_en: The sporeborn continues to infect creatures with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.EosAqVmnYlxMEGdT]{Sporeborn Infestation}, creating more of its own kind.
_desc_ko: 포자생물이 계속해서 생물을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.EosAqVmnYlxMEGdT]{포자생물 감염}으로 감염시켜, 자신과 같은 존재를 더 많이 만들어낸다.

name: (Martial Artist, Grandmaster) Life Burn Aura

description.value: The grandmaster transmutes their lifespan into an expulsion of qi. For the next minute, the grandmaster is surrounded by a 30-foot emanation that deals @Damage[3d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures who start their turn within the emanation, including the grandmaster themself. While Life Burn Aura is active, the grandmaster's fist Strikes deal 2 additional die of weapon damage. When the aura disappears, the grandmaster is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. This condition is cumulative.

_desc_en: The grandmaster transmutes their lifespan into an expulsion of qi. For the next minute, the grandmaster is surrounded by a 30-foot emanation that deals @Damage[3d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures who start their turn within the emanation, including the grandmaster themself. While Life Burn Aura is active, the grandmaster's fist Strikes deal 2 additional die of weapon damage. When the aura disappears, the grandmaster is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. This condition is cumulative.
_desc_ko: 대종사가 자신의 수명을 기(氣)의 방출로 변환한다. 다음 1분간, 대종사는 30피트 발산에 둘러싸이며, 이는 대종사 자신을 포함하여 발산 범위 안에서 턴을 시작하는 모든 생물에게 @Damage[3d6[force]|options:area-damage] 피해를 준다. 생명 연소 오라가 활성화된 동안, 대종사의 주먹 타격은 2 추가 주사위의 무기 피해를 준다. 오라가 사라지면, 대종사는 영구적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{파멸 1}이 된다. 이 상태는 누적된다.

name: (Vampire, True) Dominate

description.value:
The vampire can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait (@Check[will|dc:]). The save DC uses the high spell DC of the vampire's level, and a creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that vampire's Dominate for 24 hours.

Fully destroying the vampire ends the domination, but merely reducing the vampire to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

_desc_en:
The vampire can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait (@Check[will|dc:]). The save DC uses the high spell DC of the vampire's level, and a creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that vampire's Dominate for 24 hours.

Fully destroying the vampire ends the domination, but merely reducing the vampire to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.
_desc_ko:
뱀파이어는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{지배}를 신성 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있다. 이를 시전하려면 목표의 눈을 응시해야 하므로, 그 주문에 시각 특성이 부여된다(@Check[will|dc:]). 내성 DC는 뱀파이어 레벨의 높은 주문 DC를 사용하며, 성공한 생물은 24시간 동안 그 뱀파이어의 지배에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

뱀파이어를 완전히 파괴하면 지배가 끝나지만, 단지 뱀파이어를 HP 0으로 감소시키는 것만으로는 주문을 깨기에 충분하지 않다.

name: (Graveknight) Eager for Battle

description.value: When the graveknight rolls initiative, they roll twice and take the better result. They're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} during their first round after rolling initiative and can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

_desc_en: When the graveknight rolls initiative, they roll twice and take the better result. They're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} during their first round after rolling initiative and can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.
_desc_ko: 묘지기사가 우선권을 굴릴 때, 그들은 두 번 굴려 더 나은 결과를 취한다. 그들은 우선권을 굴린 후 첫 라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{가속} 상태이며, 이 추가 행동을 걸음, 보폭, 또는 타격에 사용할 수 있다.

name: (Mythic) Recharge

description.value:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect The creature gains one additional use of a spell or ability that is normally only available a limited number of times. For example, a spellcaster can regain an expended slot or use an ability with a frequency of once per day again.

_desc_en:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect The creature gains one additional use of a spell or ability that is normally only available a limited number of times. For example, a spellcaster can regain an expended slot or use an ability with a frequency of once per day again.
_desc_ko:
비용 신화 점수 1

효과 그 생물은 보통 제한된 횟수만 사용 가능한 주문이나 능력을 한 번 더 사용할 수 있게 된다. 예를 들어, 주문시전자는 소모된 슬롯을 되찾거나 하루 한 번 빈도의 능력을 다시 사용할 수 있다.

name: (Skeleton) Aquatic Bones

description.value: The skeleton has bones from aquatic creatures, allowing it to swim using a simple tail, paddles, or similar appendage. The skeleton has a swim Speed of 20 feet and gains the aquatic trait and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.HBrBrUzjfvj2gDXB]{Aquatic Ambush} ability.

_desc_en: The skeleton has bones from aquatic creatures, allowing it to swim using a simple tail, paddles, or similar appendage. The skeleton has a swim Speed of 20 feet and gains the aquatic trait and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.HBrBrUzjfvj2gDXB]{Aquatic Ambush} ability.
_desc_ko: 스켈레톤이 수생 생물의 뼈를 가지고 있어, 단순한 꼬리, 지느러미, 또는 유사한 부속지를 사용하여 헤엄칠 수 있다. 스켈레톤은 20피트의 수영 이동속도를 가지며 수생 특성과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.HBrBrUzjfvj2gDXB]{수중 매복} 능력을 얻는다.

name: (Ghost) Cold Spot

description.value: 5 feet. The air within 5 feet of the ghost is supernaturally cold. Characters that enter or begin their turn in the ghost's aura take @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage per 3 levels the ghost has (@Check[fortitude|dc:|basic] save).

_desc_en: 5 feet. The air within 5 feet of the ghost is supernaturally cold. Characters that enter or begin their turn in the ghost's aura take @Damage[1d6[cold]] damage per 3 levels the ghost has (@Check[fortitude|dc:|basic] save).
_desc_ko: 5피트. 유령으로부터 5피트 이내의 공기는 초자연적으로 차갑다. 유령의 오라에 진입하거나 그 안에서 턴을 시작하는 캐릭터는 유령이 가진 레벨 3당 @Damage[1d6[cold]] 피해를 받는다(@Check[fortitude|dc:|basic] 내성).

name: (Vampire, Strigoi Progenitor) Domain of Dusk

description.value:
Frequency once per minute

Effect With a wave of their hand, the strigoi calls forth vile ruination from the surrounding shadows, causing coils of darkness and shadowy bats, rats, and wolves to lash out at living targets in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Living creatures in this area take @Damage[floor(1 + @actor.level/2)d6[void]|options:area-damage] damage + 1d6 void damage per 2 levels possessed by the strigoi with a @Check[fortitude|dc:|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] save against the DC of the strigoi's level. A creature that fails this save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} by the darkness for 1 round (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 round on a critical failure).

publication.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path #215: To Blot Out the Sun

_desc_en:
Frequency once per minute

Effect With a wave of their hand, the strigoi calls forth vile ruination from the surrounding shadows, causing coils of darkness and shadowy bats, rats, and wolves to lash out at living targets in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Living creatures in this area take @Damage[floor(1 + @actor.level/2)d6[void]|options:area-damage] damage + 1d6 void damage per 2 levels possessed by the strigoi with a @Check[fortitude|dc:|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] save against the DC of the strigoi's level. A creature that fails this save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} by the darkness for 1 round (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 round on a critical failure).
_desc_ko:
빈도 분당 한 번

효과 손을 휘두르며, 스트리고이가 주위의 그림자로부터 사악한 파멸을 불러내어, 어둠의 소용돌이와 그림자 박쥐, 쥐, 늑대가 @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] 안의 살아 있는 목표를 향해 후려치게 한다. 이 범위 안의 살아 있는 생물은 @Damage[floor(1 + @actor.level/2)d6[void]|options:area-damage] 피해 + 스트리고이가 지닌 레벨 2당 1d6 공허 피해를 받으며, 스트리고이 레벨의 DC에 대한 @Check[fortitude|dc:|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] 내성을 굴린다. 이 내성에 실패한 생물은 어둠으로 인해 1라운드간 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{눈부심}(대실패 시 1라운드간 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{눈멈} 후 1라운드간 눈부심)도 된다.

name: (Vampire, Jiang-Shi, Basic) One More Breath

description.value: Unlike other undead, a jiang-shi isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and awaken in 1 minute with 1 Hit Point. Scattering at least 1 Bulk of glutinous rice or hen eggs on an unconscious jiang-shi destroys them permanently. If the jiang-shi was reduced to 0 HP by an attack from a weapon made of duskwood, they're destroyed immediately.

_desc_en: Unlike other undead, a jiang-shi isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and awaken in 1 minute with 1 Hit Point. Scattering at least 1 Bulk of glutinous rice or hen eggs on an unconscious jiang-shi destroys them permanently. If the jiang-shi was reduced to 0 HP by an attack from a weapon made of duskwood, they're destroyed immediately.
_desc_ko: 다른 언데드와 달리, 강시는 HP 0에서 파괴되지 않는다. 대신, 그들은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식}에 빠지고 1분 후 히트 포인트 1로 깨어난다. 무의식 상태의 강시에게 최소 부피 1의 찹쌀이나 계란을 뿌리면 그들을 영구적으로 파괴한다. 강시가 황혼목으로 만든 무기의 공격에 의해 HP 0으로 감소했다면, 그들은 즉시 파괴된다.

name: (Zombie) Unkillable

description.value:
This zombie is nigh unkillable. The zombie loses its weakness to slashing and gains resistance against all damage equal to its level (minimum 3), and it gains weakness equal to twice its level (minimum 6) to critical hits.

Increase the zombie's level by 1 if you give it this ability.

_desc_en:
This zombie is nigh unkillable. The zombie loses its weakness to slashing and gains resistance against all damage equal to its level (minimum 3), and it gains weakness equal to twice its level (minimum 6) to critical hits.

Increase the zombie's level by 1 if you give it this ability.
_desc_ko:
이 좀비는 거의 죽일 수 없다. 좀비는 참격에 대한 약점을 잃고 모든 피해에 대해 자신의 레벨과 동일한 저항(최소 3)을 얻으며, 대성공 공격에 대해 자신 레벨의 두 배와 동일한 약점(최소 6)을 얻는다.

이 능력을 부여하면 좀비의 레벨을 1 증가시킨다.

name: (Ghost) Site Bound

description.value: A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

_desc_en: A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.
_desc_ko: 일반적인 유령은 자신이 살해된 곳이나 자신이 출몰하는 장소로부터 짧은 거리만 벗어날 수 있다. 일반적인 한계는 120피트다. 일부 유령은 대신 장소가 아니라 자신에게 특별했던 방, 건물, 아이템, 또는 생물에 속박된다.

name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Adamantine)

description.value:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

Adamantine The stargut hydra's Strikes bypass Hardness and are treated as adamantine. The stargut hydra gains resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine).

_desc_en:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

Adamantine The stargut hydra's Strikes bypass Hardness and are treated as adamantine. The stargut hydra gains resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine).
_desc_ko:
각 별창자 히드라는 특정 하늘금속을 섭취하고 그 특성을 내재화한 결과로 최소 하나의 변형을 지닌다.

아다만틴 별창자 히드라의 타격은 견고도를 무시하며 아다만틴으로 취급된다. 별창자 히드라는 물리 피해(아다만틴 제외)에 대해 저항 10을 얻는다.

name: (Graveknight) Phantom Mount

description.value:
HP __; AC __, Fort +__, Ref +__, Will +__

The graveknight summons a supernatural mount, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount} heightened to a rank equal to half the graveknight's level. Unlike marvelous mount, the steed's AC and saving throw bonuses are all 4 lower than the graveknight's, and the steed has one-third the graveknight's Hit Points (rounded down).

If the steed is destroyed, the graveknight must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

_desc_en:
HP __; AC __, Fort +__, Ref +__, Will +__

The graveknight summons a supernatural mount, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount} heightened to a rank equal to half the graveknight's level. Unlike marvelous mount, the steed's AC and saving throw bonuses are all 4 lower than the graveknight's, and the steed has one-third the graveknight's Hit Points (rounded down).

If the steed is destroyed, the graveknight must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.
_desc_ko:
HP __; AC __, 인내 +__, 반사 +__, 의지 +__

묘지기사가 묘지기사 레벨의 절반과 동일한 랭크로 강화된 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{경이로운 탈것}처럼 초자연적인 탈것을 소환한다. 경이로운 탈것과 달리, 그 탈것의 AC와 내성 굴림 보너스는 모두 묘지기사보다 4 낮으며, 그 탈것은 묘지기사 히트 포인트의 3분의 1(내림)을 가진다.

탈것이 파괴되면, 묘지기사는 이 능력을 다시 사용하기 전에 1시간을 기다려야 한다.

name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Hungry Maw

description.value: A mouth full of razor-sharp teeth opens somewhere on the mutant's body. They gain a maw Strike (an unarmed attack that does piercing damage roughly the same as the damage dealt by their most damaging melee attack), and they gain the Vengeful Bite reaction.

_desc_en: A mouth full of razor-sharp teeth opens somewhere on the mutant's body. They gain a maw Strike (an unarmed attack that does piercing damage roughly the same as the damage dealt by their most damaging melee attack), and they gain the Vengeful Bite reaction.
_desc_ko: 면도날처럼 날카로운 이빨로 가득 찬 입이 돌연변이 몸의 어딘가에 열린다. 그들은 아가리 타격(가장 큰 피해를 주는 근접 공격의 피해와 대략 동일한 관통 피해를 주는 비무장 공격)을 얻고, 복수의 물기 반응을 얻는다.

name: (Cryptid, Rumored) Burning Eyes

description.value: The cryptid's eyes are distinctive; perhaps they burn bright red in the dark night. The rumored cryptid gains darkvision. If the base creature already has darkvision, it gains greater darkvision.

_desc_en: The cryptid's eyes are distinctive; perhaps they burn bright red in the dark night. The rumored cryptid gains darkvision. If the base creature already has darkvision, it gains greater darkvision.
_desc_ko: 크립티드의 눈은 특징적이다; 아마도 어두운 밤에 밝은 붉은빛으로 타오를 것이다. 소문의 크립티드는 암시야를 얻는다. 기본 생물이 이미 암시야를 가지고 있다면, 상급 암시야를 얻는다.

name: (Mythic) Deadly Striker

description.value: A mythic striker deals an additional 1d6 precision damage on its next Strike whenever it uses an action to Stride 10 or more feet (or to Burrow, Climb, or Fly 10 or more feet).

_desc_en: A mythic striker deals an additional 1d6 precision damage on its next Strike whenever it uses an action to Stride 10 or more feet (or to Burrow, Climb, or Fly 10 or more feet).
_desc_ko: 신화적 강타자는 10피트 이상 보폭(또는 10피트 이상 굴착, 등반, 비행)하는 데 행동을 사용할 때마다, 다음 타격에 추가 1d6 정밀 피해를 준다.

name: (Sporeborn) Fungal Armor

description.value: The sporeborn grows broad patches of dense fungus on the outside of the corpse. It gains resistance to bludgeoning damage equal to its level.

_desc_en: The sporeborn grows broad patches of dense fungus on the outside of the corpse. It gains resistance to bludgeoning damage equal to its level.
_desc_ko: 포자태생은 시체 겉면에 빽빽한 균류를 넓게 자라나게 한다. 자신의 레벨과 같은 값의 타격 피해 저항을 얻는다.

name: (Zombie) Ankle Biter

description.value: This zombie fights just as well on the ground as it does standing. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, the zombie isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, it ignores the status penalty to its attack rolls, and it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}. The zombie can also move up to half its Speed when it Crawls.

_desc_en: This zombie fights just as well on the ground as it does standing. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, the zombie isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, it ignores the status penalty to its attack rolls, and it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}. The zombie can also move up to half its Speed when it Crawls.
_desc_ko: 이 좀비는 서 있을 때만큼이나 바닥에서도 잘 싸운다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{넘어짐} 상태인 동안 좀비는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{무방비} 상태가 되지 않고, 명중 굴림에 대한 상태 페널티를 무시하며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{넘어뜨리기}를 위한 운동 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다. 좀비는 또한 기어갈 때 자신의 이동속도 절반까지 이동할 수 있다.

name: (Mythic) Mythic Immunity

description.value: The creature is immune to either harmful spells cast by non-mythic creatures, or Strikes made with non-mythic weapons and unarmed Strikes from non-mythic characters. Only the most powerful creatures (typically level 25) should be immune to both.

_desc_en: The creature is immune to either harmful spells cast by non-mythic creatures, or Strikes made with non-mythic weapons and unarmed Strikes from non-mythic characters. Only the most powerful creatures (typically level 25) should be immune to both.
_desc_ko: 이 생물은 비신화 생물이 시전한 해로운 주문에 면역이거나, 비신화 무기 및 비신화 캐릭터의 비무장 타격으로 이루어진 타격에 면역이다. 오직 가장 강력한 생물(대개 레벨 25)만이 두 가지 모두에 면역이어야 한다.

name: (Zombie) Rotting Aura

description.value:
10 feet. The zombie emits an aura of rot and disease that causes wounds to fester.

Any living creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie and is not at full Hit Points takes @Damage[1d6[void]] damage. This damage increases by 1d6 for every 6 levels the zombie has.

_desc_en:
10 feet. The zombie emits an aura of rot and disease that causes wounds to fester.

Any living creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie and is not at full Hit Points takes @Damage[1d6[void]] damage. This damage increases by 1d6 for every 6 levels the zombie has.
_desc_ko:
10피트. 좀비는 부패와 질병의 오라를 발산하여 상처를 곪게 한다.

좀비로부터 10피트 이내에서 자기 턴을 시작하는 완전한 체력이 아닌 살아 있는 생물은 @Damage[1d6[void]] 피해를 받는다. 이 피해는 좀비의 레벨 6마다 1d6씩 증가한다.

name: (Cinder Dragon) Cloud of Ashes

description.value:
The dragon blows a cloud of ashes and smoke out through their scales, surrounding themself in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] that lasts until the end of their next turn. All creatures within the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to both sight and scent, and all creatures outside the cloud are concealed to creatures within it. Any creature that enters the area or begins its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Pyre Breath.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature begins coughing and until the start of its next turn it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] if it attempts any action that requires it to speak, or it loses the action.

Critical Failure As failure, plus it must immediately spend its next action coughing.

_desc_en:
The dragon blows a cloud of ashes and smoke out through their scales, surrounding themself in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] that lasts until the end of their next turn. All creatures within the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to both sight and scent, and all creatures outside the cloud are concealed to creatures within it. Any creature that enters the area or begins its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Pyre Breath.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature begins coughing and until the start of its next turn it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] if it attempts any action that requires it to speak, or it loses the action.

Critical Failure As failure, plus it must immediately spend its next action coughing.
_desc_ko:
용은 비늘 틈으로 재와 연기의 구름을 뿜어내어, 자신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되는 @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] 범위로 자신을 감싼다. 구름 안의 모든 생물은 시각과 후각 양쪽에 대해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐} 상태가 되고, 구름 밖의 모든 생물은 구름 안의 생물에게 은폐된다. 이 범위에 들어오거나 이 범위에서 자기 턴을 시작하는 생물은 용의 화장 숨결과 동일한 DC로 @Check[fortitude] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

성공 생물은 영향을 받지 않는다.

실패 생물은 기침을 시작하며, 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 말이 필요한 행동을 시도하려면 @Check[flat|dc:5]에 성공해야 하고, 그러지 못하면 그 행동을 잃는다.

대실패 실패와 동일하며, 추가로 즉시 다음 행동을 기침하는 데 소비해야 한다.

name: (Siabrae) Earth Glide

description.value: The siabrae can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the siabrae moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

_desc_en: The siabrae can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the siabrae moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.
_desc_ko: 시아브래는 바위를 포함한 어떤 흙 물질도 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{굴착}할 수 있다. 그렇게 할 때 시아브래는 완전한 굴착 이동속도로 움직이며, 터널이나 지나간 흔적을 전혀 남기지 않는다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Change Shape

description.value:
The nosferatu transforms into a swarm of pale-gray rats. They gain a land Speed of 30 feet and a climb Speed of 10 feet, and they become Large. In this swarm form, the nosferatu can take an action to deal each enemy in the swarm's space @Damage[2d10[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] save, with a high DC for the nosferatu's level. A creature that fails its save is also exposed to plague of ancients.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

_desc_ko:
노스페라투는 창백한 회색 쥐 떼로 변신한다. 지상 이동속도 30피트와 등반 이동속도 10피트를 얻고, 크기가 대형이 된다. 이 무리 형상일 때 노스페라투는 한 행동을 사용하여 무리가 차지한 공간 안의 각 적에게 @Damage[2d10[piercing]|options:area-damage] 피해를, 노스페라투의 레벨에 맞는 높은 DC의 @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] 내성과 함께 가할 수 있다. 내성에 실패한 생물은 또한 고대인의 역병에 노출된다.

name: (Divine Warden) Divine Innate Spells

description.value: A divine warden gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwZBXN6zBoB9BHXE]{Divine Lance} as an innate cantrip.

_desc_en: A divine warden gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwZBXN6zBoB9BHXE]{Divine Lance} as an innate cantrip.

name: (Despair Dragon) Cursed Memories

description.value: 90 feet. Creatures near a despair dragon can't trust their own minds. When any creature in the aura attempts a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, they must roll twice and take the lower result.

_desc_en: 90 feet. Creatures near a despair dragon can't trust their own minds. When any creature in the aura attempts a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, they must roll twice and take the lower result.
_desc_ko: 90피트. 절망 용 근처의 생물은 자신의 정신을 믿을 수 없다. 오라 안의 어떤 생물이든 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{지식 회상}을 위한 기술 판정을 시도할 때, 두 번 굴려 더 낮은 결과를 취해야 한다.

name: (Union Organizer) Solidarity

description.value:
10 feet.

While leading a demonstration, the union organizer grants themself and their allies a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fatigue and mental effects. Greater numbers amplify the effect. The emanation increases to 20 feet if there are at least 5 allies within 10 feet, and to 30 feet if there are at least 10 allies within 20 feet.

_desc_en:
10 feet.

While leading a demonstration, the union organizer grants themself and their allies a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fatigue and mental effects. Greater numbers amplify the effect. The emanation increases to 20 feet if there are at least 5 allies within 10 feet, and to 30 feet if there are at least 10 allies within 20 feet.
_desc_ko:
10피트.

시위를 이끄는 동안, 노조 조직가는 자신과 아군에게 피로 및 정신 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 +1 상황 보너스를 부여한다. 인원이 많을수록 효과가 증폭된다. 10피트 이내에 아군이 5명 이상 있으면 발산 범위가 20피트로, 20피트 이내에 아군이 10명 이상 있으면 30피트로 늘어난다.

name: (Sporeborn) Sporeborn Infestation

name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Basic) Drain Thoughts

description.value:
Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vetalarana's reach

Effect The vetalarana seizes a creature and consumes its memories. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and the vetalarana regains HP equal to 10% of the vetalarana's maximum HP, gaining any excess as temporary Hit Points. Draining Thoughts from a creature that is already stupefied doesn't restore any HP to the vetalarana but increases the victim's stupefied value by 1. Additionally, the vetalarana views one of the victim's memories.

A victim's stupefied condition value decreases by 1 every week.

A victim that becomes stupefied 5 in this way is rendered comatose, becoming permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. As long as the vetalarana lives, a comatose victim can't regain consciousness, and its stupefied condition doesn't decrease.

Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vetalarana's reach

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and the vetalarana regains HP equal to 10% of the vetalarana's maximum HP, gaining any excess as temporary Hit Points. Draining Thoughts from a creature that is already stupefied doesn't restore any HP to the vetalarana but increases the victim's stupefied value by 1. A victim that becomes stupefied 5 in this way is rendered comatose, becoming permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. As long as the vetalarana lives, a comatose victim can't regain consciousness, and its stupefied condition doesn't decrease.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{마비}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식} 상태이거나 자발적인 생물이 베탈라라나의 사거리 내에 있어야 함

효과 베탈라라나는 생물을 붙잡고 그 기억을 삼킨다. 이는 피해자가 붙잡힘 상태일 경우 피해자의 건강 DC에 대한 @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] 판정을 요구하며, 그 외의 조건들에 대해서는 자동으로 성공한다. 피해자는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1} 상태가 되고, 베탈라라나는 자신의 최대 HP의 10%에 해당하는 HP를 회복하며 초과분은 임시 체력으로 얻는다. 이미 멍함 상태인 생물로부터 사념을 흡수하면 베탈라라나에게 HP가 회복되지 않지만 피해자의 멍청함 값이 1 증가한다. 추가로, 베탈라라나는 피해자의 기억 중 하나를 들여다본다.

피해자의 멍청함 조건 값은 매주 1씩 감소한다.

이 방식으로 멍함 5가 된 피해자는 혼수상태에 빠져 영구적으로 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식} 상태가 된다. 베탈라라나가 살아 있는 한, 혼수상태의 피해자는 의식을 되찾을 수 없으며 멍청함 조건도 감소하지 않는다.

name: (Floodslain) Floodslain Spawn

description.value: A living animal or humanoid killed by a floodslain creature will rise as a floodslain if their corpse is left in water for 24 hours. The new floodslain isn't under the control of the floodslain creature that killed it.

_desc_en: A living animal or humanoid killed by a floodslain creature will rise as a floodslain if their corpse is left in water for 24 hours. The new floodslain isn't under the control of the floodslain creature that killed it.
_desc_ko: 수몰사자 생물에게 죽임당한 살아 있는 동물이나 인간형은, 그 시체가 24시간 동안 물속에 남겨지면 수몰사자로 일어난다. 새 수몰사자는 자신을 죽인 수몰사자 생물의 통제를 받지 않는다.

name: (Siabrae) Miasma

description.value:
20 foot. @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened]{DC equal to the siabrae's spell DC - 4}.

A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn there becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a failure (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} on a critical failure). An animal, fey, or plant that rolls a failure gets a critical failure instead. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to the siabrae's miasma for 1 minute.

_desc_en:
20 foot. @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened]{DC equal to the siabrae's spell DC - 4}.

A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn there becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a failure (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} on a critical failure). An animal, fey, or plant that rolls a failure gets a critical failure instead. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to the siabrae's miasma for 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
20피트. @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened]{시아브래의 주문 DC - 4에 해당하는 DC}.

오라에 들어오거나 그곳에서 자기 턴을 시작하는 생물은 실패 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 2}(대실패 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 4}) 상태가 된다. 실패를 굴린 동물, 페이, 식물은 대신 대실패가 된다. 내성 굴림 결과와 관계없이, 그 생물은 1분간 시아브래의 독기에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Paralytic Fear

description.value:
Requirements The nosferatu overlord's last action was a successful claw Strike

Effect The nosferatu drags the target of the Strike close and freezes its mind in terror. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:|options:inflicts:frightened,inflicts:immobilized,inflicts:restrained] save with a moderate DC for the nosferatu's level.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by fear until the end of the nosferatu's next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Fortitude DC against the nosferatu's Drink Blood ability until the end of the nosferatu's next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

_desc_en:
Requirements The nosferatu overlord's last action was a successful claw Strike

Effect The nosferatu drags the target of the Strike close and freezes its mind in terror. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:|options:inflicts:frightened,inflicts:immobilized,inflicts:restrained] save with a moderate DC for the nosferatu's level.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by fear until the end of the nosferatu's next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Fortitude DC against the nosferatu's Drink Blood ability until the end of the nosferatu's next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 노스페라투 군주의 마지막 행동이 성공한 발톱 타격이었음

효과 노스페라투는 타격 대상을 가까이 끌어당겨 그 정신을 공포로 얼어붙게 한다. 대상은 노스페라투의 레벨에 맞는 보통 DC로 @Check[will|dc:|options:inflicts:frightened,inflicts:immobilized,inflicts:restrained] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

대성공 대상은 영향을 받지 않는다.

성공 대상은 노스페라투의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 공포에 의해 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{이동 불가} 상태가 된다.

실패 대상은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제} 상태가 되며, 노스페라투의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 노스페라투의 피 마시기 능력에 대한 자신의 건강 DC에 –2 상황 페널티를 받는다.

대실패 실패와 동일하며, 대상은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2} 상태가 된다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Divine Innate Spells

description.value: The nosferatu can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul} (heightened to half their level rounded up) three times per day as a divine innate spell. They use a high DC for their level.

_desc_en: The nosferatu can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul} (heightened to half their level rounded up) three times per day as a divine innate spell. They use a high DC for their level.
_desc_ko: 노스페라투는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{염동 운반}(자신의 레벨 절반을 올림한 값으로 강화됨)을 하루 세 번 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 자신의 레벨에 맞는 높은 DC를 사용한다.

name: (Lich) Animate Cage

description.value: The lich has placed their soul cage inside an animated object that fights fiercely to defend itself, or at the very least to elude capture. If the lich's body is destroyed, the lich can control this animated object directly, although they can't cast any spells while inside the vessel. The lich's body is often restored inside this object, being ejected from the animated object after 1d10 days in the normal manner for a soul cage. The animated object is usually at least 4 levels lower than the lich, but it doesn't engage in combat unless directly threatened or if the lich is in control of it.

_desc_en: The lich has placed their soul cage inside an animated object that fights fiercely to defend itself, or at the very least to elude capture. If the lich's body is destroyed, the lich can control this animated object directly, although they can't cast any spells while inside the vessel. The lich's body is often restored inside this object, being ejected from the animated object after 1d10 days in the normal manner for a soul cage. The animated object is usually at least 4 levels lower than the lich, but it doesn't engage in combat unless directly threatened or if the lich is in control of it.
_desc_ko: 리치는 자신을 방어하기 위해, 또는 최소한 포획을 피하기 위해 맹렬히 싸우는 활성화된 물체 안에 영혼 우리를 넣어두었다. 리치의 몸이 파괴되면 리치는 이 활성화된 물체를 직접 조종할 수 있으나, 그릇 안에 있는 동안에는 어떤 주문도 시전할 수 없다. 리치의 몸은 흔히 이 물체 안에서 복원되며, 영혼 우리의 일반적인 방식대로 1d10일 후 활성화된 물체에서 배출된다. 활성화된 물체는 대개 리치보다 적어도 4레벨 낮으나, 직접 위협받거나 리치가 이를 조종하고 있지 않은 한 전투에 참여하지 않는다.

name: (Zombie) Putrid Stench

description.value:
15 feet. The zombie's rotting flesh is particularly malodorous. A creature that enters the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and on a critical failure, the creature also takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all zombies' putrid stenches for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.xmES7HVxM7L3j1EN]{Effect: Putrid Stench}

While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves to recover from the sickened condition. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.xmES7HVxM7L3j1EN]{Effect: Putrid Stench}
_desc_ko:
15피트. 좀비의 썩어가는 살점은 특히 악취가 심하다. 이 범위에 들어오는 생물은 @Check[fortitude|dc:] 내성을 시도해야 한다. 실패 시 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1} 상태가 되고, 대실패 시에는 추가로 1라운드 동안 이동속도에 –5피트 상태 페널티를 받는다. 오라 안에 있는 동안 생물은 구역질 조건에서 회복하기 위한 내성에 –2 상황 페널티를 받는다. 내성에 성공한 생물은 1분간 모든 좀비의 썩은 악취에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.xmES7HVxM7L3j1EN]{효과: 썩은 악취}

name: (Resurrection Dragon) Harmful Claw

description.value:
The resurrection dragon channels a divine spell into their claw. They Cast a 1-action version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}, but the effects of the spell don't occur immediately. The dragon then makes a claw Strike. This counts as two attacks for the dragon's multiple attack penalty. The attack is imbued with the spell's effects according to the results of the Strike.

Critical Success The Strike deals double damage as normal, and the target must attempt a basic Fortitude save against the spell's damage, but treats its result as one degree of success worse.

Success The Strike deals damage as normal, and the target attempts a basic Fortitude save against the spell's damage.

Failure The Strike deals no damage, but the target must attempt a basic Fortitude save against the spell's damage.

Critical Failure The Strike deals no damage, and the target is unaffected by the spell.

_desc_en:
The resurrection dragon channels a divine spell into their claw. They Cast a 1-action version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}, but the effects of the spell don't occur immediately. The dragon then makes a claw Strike. This counts as two attacks for the dragon's multiple attack penalty. The attack is imbued with the spell's effects according to the results of the Strike.

Critical Success The Strike deals double damage as normal, and the target must attempt a basic Fortitude save against the spell's damage, but treats its result as one degree of success worse.

Success The Strike deals damage as normal, and the target attempts a basic Fortitude save against the spell's damage.

Failure The Strike deals no damage, but the target must attempt a basic Fortitude save against the spell's damage.

Critical Failure The Strike deals no damage, and the target is unaffected by the spell.
_desc_ko:
부활 용은 신성 주문을 자신의 발톱에 불어넣는다. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{해악}의 1행동 버전을 시전하되, 주문의 효과는 즉시 발생하지 않는다. 그런 다음 용은 발톱 타격을 한다. 이는 용의 다중공격 페널티에 대해 두 번의 공격으로 계산된다. 이 공격은 타격의 결과에 따라 주문의 효과가 깃든다.

대성공 타격은 평소대로 두 배 피해를 가하며, 대상은 주문의 피해에 대해 기본 건강 내성을 시도해야 하되 그 결과를 한 단계 낮은 성공 등급으로 취급한다.

성공 타격은 평소대로 피해를 가하며, 대상은 주문의 피해에 대해 기본 건강 내성을 시도한다.

실패 타격은 피해를 가하지 않지만, 대상은 주문의 피해에 대해 기본 건강 내성을 시도해야 한다.

대실패 타격은 피해를 가하지 않으며, 대상은 주문의 영향을 받지 않는다.

name: (Werecreature) Moon Frenzy

description.value:
When a full moon appears in the night sky, the werecreature must enter hybrid form, can't Change Shape thereafter, becomes one size larger, increases its reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of its jaws by 2.

When the moon sets or the sun rises, the werecreature returns to humanoid form and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for [[/br 2d4 #hours]]{2d4 hours}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{Effect: Moon Frenzy}

_desc_en:
When a full moon appears in the night sky, the werecreature must enter hybrid form, can't Change Shape thereafter, becomes one size larger, increases its reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of its jaws by 2.

When the moon sets or the sun rises, the werecreature returns to humanoid form and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for [[/br 2d4 #hours]]{2d4 hours}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{Effect: Moon Frenzy}
_desc_ko:
밤하늘에 보름달이 뜨면, 웨어크리처는 반드시 혼종 형상에 들어가야 하고, 그 후로는 형상 변화를 할 수 없으며, 크기가 한 단계 커지고, 사거리가 5피트 늘어나며, 턱의 피해가 2 증가한다.

달이 지거나 해가 뜨면, 웨어크리처는 인간형 형상으로 돌아오며 [[/br 2d4 #hours]]{2d4시간} 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{피로} 상태가 된다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{효과: 달의 광란}

name: (Horned Dragon) Horn Projectile

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Effect The dragon hurls a fragment of its horn at a target within 40 feet. The target takes the same damage as the dragon's horn Strike and must attempt a @Check[reflex|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:immobilized] save.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} as the horn fragment pins them to the nearest surface.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double damage and @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage as the fragment pierces their body.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

_desc_ko:
빈도 라운드당 한 번

효과 용은 40피트 이내의 대상에게 자신의 뿔 파편을 던진다. 대상은 용의 뿔 타격과 동일한 피해를 받고 @Check[reflex|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:immobilized] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

대성공 대상은 피해를 받지 않는다.

성공 대상은 피해의 절반을 받는다.

실패 대상은 온전한 피해를 받으며, 뿔 파편이 대상을 가장 가까운 표면에 꽂아버려 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{이동 불가} 상태가 된다.

대실패 실패와 동일하되, 대상은 두 배 피해를 받고 파편이 몸을 꿰뚫어 @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] 피해를 받는다.

name: (Ghoul) Paralysis

description.value: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:inflicts:paralyzed] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

_desc_en: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:inflicts:paralyzed] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.
_desc_ko: 구울의 공격에 맞은 엘프가 아닌 살아 있는 생물은 @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:inflicts:paralyzed] 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{마비} 상태가 된다. 매 턴이 끝날 때 새로운 내성을 시도할 수 있으며, 그때마다 DC가 누적하여 1씩 감소한다.

name: (Vampire, Basic) Coffin Restoration

description.value: Unlike other undead, a vampire isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If its body rests in its coffin for 1 hour, the vampire gains 1 HP, after which its fast healing begins to function normally.

_desc_en: Unlike other undead, a vampire isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If its body rests in its coffin for 1 hour, the vampire gains 1 HP, after which its fast healing begins to function normally.
_desc_ko: 다른 언데드와 달리, 뱀파이어는 0 HP에서 파괴되지 않는다. 대신 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식} 상태로 쓰러진다. 그 몸이 1시간 동안 관 속에서 쉬면 뱀파이어는 1 HP를 얻고, 그 후 빠른 치유가 정상적으로 작동하기 시작한다.

name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Mirror Thing

description.value: The mutant takes on the specific appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid they can currently see. This doesn't alter their statistics, but it might change the damage type of their Strikes.

_desc_en: The mutant takes on the specific appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid they can currently see. This doesn't alter their statistics, but it might change the damage type of their Strikes.
_desc_ko: 돌연변이는 현재 볼 수 있는 소형이나 중형 인간형의 구체적인 외양을 취한다. 이는 그들의 능력치 수치를 바꾸지 않지만, 타격의 피해 유형을 바꿀 수 있다.

name: (Ravener) Soul Ward

description.value:
An intangible field of necromantic energy protects a ravener from total destruction. A soul ward has 150 maximum Hit Points, or 200 if the ravener is level 21 or higher.

Whenever a ravener would be reduced below 1 Hit Point, all damage in excess of what would reduce them to 1 Hit Point is instead dealt to their soul ward. If this damage reduces the soul ward to fewer than 0 Hit Points, the ravener is destroyed.

A soul ward's Hit Points can be restored only via specific ravener abilities such as Consume Soul, ravenous breath, or vicious criticals. A ravener who goes more than a week without successfully using Consume Soul to feed on a dying creature starves, and their soul ward loses @Damage[1d4[untyped]] Hit Points each day until they feed. If the ravener's soul ward loses all its Hit Points while the ravener still has more than 1 HP, they become a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.OK7Gl2rBDDBvICvh]{Ravener Husk}.

_desc_en:
An intangible field of necromantic energy protects a ravener from total destruction. A soul ward has 150 maximum Hit Points, or 200 if the ravener is level 21 or higher.

Whenever a ravener would be reduced below 1 Hit Point, all damage in excess of what would reduce them to 1 Hit Point is instead dealt to their soul ward. If this damage reduces the soul ward to fewer than 0 Hit Points, the ravener is destroyed.

A soul ward's Hit Points can be restored only via specific ravener abilities such as Consume Soul, ravenous breath, or vicious criticals. A ravener who goes more than a week without successfully using Consume Soul to feed on a dying creature starves, and their soul ward loses @Damage[1d4[untyped]] Hit Points each day until they feed. If the ravener's soul ward loses all its Hit Points while the ravener still has more than 1 HP, they become a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.OK7Gl2rBDDBvICvh]{Ravener Husk}.
_desc_ko:
사령술 에너지의 무형 장막이 레이버너를 완전한 파괴로부터 보호한다. 영혼 보호막은 최대 150 체력을 가지며, 레이버너가 레벨 21 이상이면 200이다.

레이버너가 1 체력 미만으로 떨어질 때마다, 그를 1 체력까지 떨어뜨리는 데 필요한 양을 초과하는 모든 피해는 대신 그의 영혼 보호막에 가해진다. 이 피해가 영혼 보호막을 0 체력 미만으로 떨어뜨리면 레이버너는 파괴된다.

영혼 보호막의 체력은 영혼 삼키기, 게걸스러운 숨결, 흉악한 급소 공격 같은 특정 레이버너 능력을 통해서만 회복할 수 있다. 일주일 넘게 빈사 생물을 영혼 삼키기로 성공적으로 먹지 못한 레이버너는 굶주리며, 먹을 때까지 매일 영혼 보호막이 @Damage[1d4[untyped]] 체력을 잃는다. 레이버너가 아직 1 HP를 초과해 가지고 있는 동안 영혼 보호막이 모든 체력을 잃으면, 그는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.OK7Gl2rBDDBvICvh]{레이버너 껍데기}가 된다.

name: (Melfesh Monster) Burrowing Grasp

description.value: The Melfesh Monster Burrows twice. At any point in this movement, it can shed a temporary fungal limb to grasp a creature within 10 feet. The creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:21|name:Burrowing Grasp|options:inflicts:immobilized] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round (on a critical failure, 2 rounds) or until it [[/act escape dc=21]]{Escapes}. This ability grants the Melfesh Monster a burrow speed of 15 feet and replaces its fly speed and Envelop.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

The creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:21|name:Burrowing Grasp|options:inflicts:immobilized] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round (on a critical failure, 2 rounds) or until it [[/act escape dc=21]]{Escapes}. This ability grants the Melfesh Monster a burrow speed of 15 feet and replaces its fly speed and Envelop.
_desc_ko: 멜페시 몬스터는 두 번 굴착한다. 이 이동 중 어느 시점에든, 일시적인 균류 팔다리를 뻗어 10피트 이내의 생물을 움켜쥘 수 있다. 그 생물은 @Check[reflex|dc:21|name:Burrowing Grasp|options:inflicts:immobilized] 내성에 성공하지 못하면 1라운드(대실패 시 2라운드) 동안 또는 [[/act escape dc=21]]{탈출}할 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{이동 불가} 상태가 된다. 이 능력은 멜페시 몬스터에게 15피트의 굴착 이동속도를 부여하며, 비행 이동속도와 감싸기를 대체한다.

name: (Zombie, Shock) Arcing Strikes

description.value: When a shock zombie hits a creature with a melee attack, an arc of lighting leaps to a second creature, dealing @Damage[1d12[electricity]] damage. This secondary target must be within 10 feet of the shock zombie's original target and must be the creature closest to the original target (if multiple creatures are equidistant, the shock zombie chooses which to affect).

_desc_en: When a shock zombie hits a creature with a melee attack, an arc of lighting leaps to a second creature, dealing @Damage[1d12[electricity]] damage. This secondary target must be within 10 feet of the shock zombie's original target and must be the creature closest to the original target (if multiple creatures are equidistant, the shock zombie chooses which to affect).
_desc_ko: 감전 좀비가 근접 공격으로 생물을 명중시키면, 번개 방전이 두 번째 생물에게 튀어 @Damage[1d12[electricity]] 피해를 가한다. 이 두 번째 대상은 감전 좀비의 원래 대상으로부터 10피트 이내에 있어야 하며, 원래 대상에 가장 가까운 생물이어야 한다(여러 생물이 같은 거리에 있으면 감전 좀비가 어느 것을 영향받게 할지 선택한다).

name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Basic) Thoughtsense 100 feet

description.value: The vetalarana senses all non-mindless creatures within 100 feet as a precise sense.

_desc_en: The vetalarana senses all non-mindless creatures within 100 feet as a precise sense.
_desc_ko: 베탈라라나는 100피트 이내의 정신이 없지 않은 모든 생물을 정밀 감각으로 감지한다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Drink Blood

description.value:
Requirements The nosferatu's last action was a successful fangs Strike

Effect The nosferatu sinks their fangs into the targeted creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, and the nosferatu regains HP equal to 10% of their maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the nosferatu but increases the creature's drained condition value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}. A nosferatu can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but they gain no HP from doing so.

The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:20] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirements The nosferatu's last action was a successful fangs Strike

Effect The nosferatu sinks their fangs into the targeted creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, and the nosferatu regains HP equal to 10% of their maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the nosferatu but increases the creature's drained condition value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 5}. A nosferatu can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but they gain no HP from doing so.

The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:20] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 노스페라투의 마지막 행동이 성공한 송곳니 타격이었음

효과 노스페라투는 대상 생물에게 송곳니를 박아 그 피를 마신다. 이는 생물의 건강 DC에 대한 @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] 판정을 요구한다. 성공 시 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 1} 상태가 되고, 노스페라투는 자신의 최대 HP의 10%에 해당하는 HP를 회복하며 초과분은 임시 체력으로 얻는다. 이미 생명력 고갈 상태인 생물의 피를 마시면 노스페라투에게 HP가 회복되지 않지만 생물의 생명력 고갈 조건 값이 1 증가하며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 5}에 도달하면 피해자가 사망한다. 노스페라투는 또한 그릇에 담긴 피를 섭취하여 자양분을 얻을 수 있으나, 그렇게 해서는 HP를 얻지 못한다.

대상 생물의 생명력 고갈 조건 값은 매주 1씩 감소한다. 성공적인 @Check[medicine|dc:20] 판정과 충분한 피 또는 헌혈자를 필요로 하는 수혈은 10분 후 생명력 고갈 값을 1 감소시킨다.

name: (Sporeborn) Spore Explosion

description.value: When the sporeborn is destroyed, its body explodes, releasing toxic fumes and spores. Adjacent creatures take @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage per 2 levels (minimum 1d6) with a @Check[fortitude|dc:|basic] save.

_desc_en: When the sporeborn is destroyed, its body explodes, releasing toxic fumes and spores. Adjacent creatures take @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage per 2 levels (minimum 1d6) with a @Check[fortitude|dc:|basic] save.
_desc_ko: 포자태생이 파괴되면 그 몸이 폭발하여 독성 연기와 포자를 방출한다. 인접한 생물은 레벨 2마다 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 피해(최소 1d6)를 @Check[fortitude|dc:|basic] 내성과 함께 받는다.

name: (Beheaded) Entangling

description.value: Long, stringy hair clings to the beheaded's scalp. Its Strikes gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab} ability.

_desc_en: Long, stringy hair clings to the beheaded's scalp. Its Strikes gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab} ability.
_desc_ko: 길고 가느다란 머리카락이 참수체의 두피에 달라붙어 있다. 그 타격은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{붙잡기} 능력을 얻는다.
