name: (Lich) Aura of Rot

description.value: The lich is surrounded by pervasive, supernatural rot. Unattended food and drink within 30 feet of the lich immediately spoils. Anyone attempting to eat or drink within this area must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as the sustenance spoils before it can be ingested (ruining potions and other magical food and drink). Ordinary plants that remain within this aura for more than 1 minute wither and begin to die (depending on their size, this might take significantly longer).

_desc_en: The lich is surrounded by pervasive, supernatural rot. Unattended food and drink within 30 feet of the lich immediately spoils. Anyone attempting to eat or drink within this area must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} as the sustenance spoils before it can be ingested (ruining potions and other magical food and drink). Ordinary plants that remain within this aura for more than 1 minute wither and begin to die (depending on their size, this might take significantly longer).
_desc_ko: 리치는 만연한 초자연적 부패에 둘러싸여 있다. 리치로부터 30피트 이내에서 손대지 않은 음식과 음료는 즉시 상한다. 이 지역 안에서 먹거나 마시려는 자는 누구든 @Check[flat|dc:5]에 성공해야 하며, 그러지 못하면 섭취되기 전에 자양분이 상하여 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1} 상태가 된다(물약 및 기타 마법 음식과 음료를 망침). 이 오라 안에 1분 넘게 머무는 평범한 식물은 시들며 죽기 시작한다(크기에 따라 이는 상당히 더 오래 걸릴 수 있다).

name: (Graveknight) Betrayed Revivification

description.value:
The graveknight died after being deeply betrayed.

Instead of being immune to a type of energy damage, it is immune to mental damage, its weapons deal @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage, and its Devastating Blast deals mental damage with a Will saving throw instead of Reflex.

Instead of being immune to a type of energy damage, it is immune to mental damage, its weapons deal @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage, and its Devastating Blast deals mental damage with a Will saving throw instead of Reflex.
_desc_ko:
이 그레이브나이트는 깊은 배신을 당한 후 죽었다.

특정 유형의 에너지 피해에 면역인 대신, 정신 피해에 면역이며, 무기가 @Damage[1d6[mental]] 피해를 입히고, 파멸적 폭발이 반사 대신 의지 내성을 동반한 정신 피해를 입힌다.

name: (Clockwork Creature) Malfunction - Backfire

description.value: The clockwork rolls a @Check[flat|dc:5] at the start of each of its turns. On a failure, it backfires, dealing @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[cone|distance:15], including to itself (@Check[reflex|basic|dc:0|options:area-effect] save at the standard DC for its level), and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} this turn.

_desc_ko: 태엽 생물은 자신의 각 턴 시작 시 @Check[flat|dc:5]를 굴린다. 실패 시 역발하여, @Template[cone|distance:15] 내에 자신을 포함해 @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] 피해를 입히고(자신의 레벨에 맞는 표준 DC로 @Check[reflex|basic|dc:0|options:area-effect] 내성), 이번 턴 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태가 된다.

name: (Cinder Dragon) Inextinguishable Aura

description.value: 90 feet. Flames burn underwater in this aura and cannot be doused by non-magical water. When a creature within this aura attempts a flat check to end persistent fire damage, it must roll twice and take the worse result.

_desc_en: 90 feet. Flames burn underwater in this aura and cannot be doused by non-magical water. When a creature within this aura attempts a flat check to end persistent fire damage, it must roll twice and take the worse result.
_desc_ko: 90피트. 이 오라 안에서는 불꽃이 수중에서도 타오르며 마법이 아닌 물로는 끌 수 없다. 이 오라 안의 생물이 지속 화염 피해를 종료하기 위해 평판정을 시도할 때, 두 번 굴려 더 나쁜 결과를 취해야 한다.

name: (Cryptid, Experimental) Energy Wave

description.value: The experimental cryptid unleashes a @Template[line|distance:30] of energy of a type specific to the experimental cryptid (typically electricity or fire). Creatures in the area take @Damage[1d6[damagetype]|options:area-damage]{1d6 damage per level of the cryptid} with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|options:area-effect] save. The experimental cryptid can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Energy Wave]]{1d4 rounds}. This action has the damage type's trait. If the experiments that reshaped the creature were magical, this action also has the evocation trait and the trait matching the magical tradition of the experiments (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

_desc_en: The experimental cryptid unleashes a @Template[line|distance:30] of energy of a type specific to the experimental cryptid (typically electricity or fire). Creatures in the area take @Damage[1d6[damagetype]|options:area-damage]{1d6 damage per level of the cryptid} with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|options:area-effect] save. The experimental cryptid can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Energy Wave]]{1d4 rounds}. This action has the damage type's trait. If the experiments that reshaped the creature were magical, this action also has the evocation trait and the trait matching the magical tradition of the experiments (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
_desc_ko: 실험체 크립티드는 그 실험체 크립티드 고유의 유형(보통 전기나 화염)의 @Template[line|distance:30] 에너지를 방출한다. 그 지역의 생물은 @Damage[1d6[damagetype]|options:area-damage]{크립티드 레벨당 1d6 피해}를 받으며 @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|options:area-effect] 내성을 굴린다. 실험체 크립티드는 이 능력을 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Energy Wave]]{1d4 라운드}마다 한 번 사용할 수 있다. 이 행동은 해당 피해 유형의 특성을 가진다. 이 생물을 재형성한 실험이 마법적이었다면, 이 행동은 또한 방출 특성과 그 실험의 마법 전통에 해당하는 특성(비전, 신성, 비학, 또는 원시)을 가진다.

name: (Zombie) Persistent Limbs

description.value: The first time the zombie is critically hit with a melee or ranged Strike, a limb falls off its body and continues to attack. The limb acts on the zombie's initiative; each round it can Stride up to half the zombie's Speed and make a Strike. The limb uses and contributes to the zombie's multiple attack penalty.

_desc_en: The first time the zombie is critically hit with a melee or ranged Strike, a limb falls off its body and continues to attack. The limb acts on the zombie's initiative; each round it can Stride up to half the zombie's Speed and make a Strike. The limb uses and contributes to the zombie's multiple attack penalty.
_desc_ko: 좀비가 근접 또는 원거리 타격으로 처음 결정타를 맞으면, 사지 하나가 몸에서 떨어져 나가 계속 공격한다. 그 사지는 좀비의 우선권으로 행동한다; 매 라운드 좀비 이동 속도의 절반까지 보폭하고 타격을 할 수 있다. 그 사지는 좀비의 다중공격 페널티를 사용하며 그것에 기여한다.

name: (Cryptid, Rumored) Creature Obscura

description.value: The cryptid appears in so many urban legends, it can be identified using Society or a Lore skill connected to a nearby settlement, in addition to the normal skills. However, much of the information known about it is dubious. The DC to identify a rumored cryptid is incredibly hard (rather than very hard for most rare creatures), but all failures to identify a rumored cryptid gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.

_desc_en: The cryptid appears in so many urban legends, it can be identified using Society or a Lore skill connected to a nearby settlement, in addition to the normal skills. However, much of the information known about it is dubious. The DC to identify a rumored cryptid is incredibly hard (rather than very hard for most rare creatures), but all failures to identify a rumored cryptid gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.
_desc_ko: 이 크립티드는 수많은 도시 전설에 등장하기에, 통상적인 기술에 더해 사회 또는 인근 정착지와 연관된 지식 기술로도 식별할 수 있다. 그러나 그에 대해 알려진 정보의 상당수는 의심스럽다. 소문체 크립티드를 식별하는 DC는 믿을 수 없을 만큼 어렵지만(대부분의 희귀 생물이 매우 어려운 것과 대조적으로), 소문체 크립티드 식별에 실패한 모든 경우 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{의심스러운 지식} 기술 재주의 효과를 얻는다.

name: (Vampire, Strigoi) Strigoi Weaknesses

description.value:
All strigoi possess the following weaknesses:

  • Revulsion Strigoi are uncomfortable near mirrors or sources of bright light. Only a strigoi's shadow reflects in a mirror, and this often compels them to cover or destroy mirrors in their presence rather than risk their true nature being displayed. A strigoi can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or source of bright light. To brandish a mirror or light source, a creature must Interact to do so for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the strigoi involuntarily comes within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or light source, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the brandished object until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a strigoi can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #Overcome Revulsions Duration]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success). A strigoi can move normally around mirrors or bright light sources that are not brandished, although doing so causes them discomfort that can be noticed with a successful Perception check to [[/act sense-motive]].

  • Sunlight When exposed to direct sunlight, a strigoi immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and falls to the ground. They appear to be dead: they don't breathe, their body temperature matches their surroundings, and they don't react to pain or other stimuli. A successful @Check[perception|against:reflex] check against the strigoi's Reflex DC is enough to note one anomaly: the shadow cast by their "dead" body shifts and moves slightly, its edges twisting and active. Certain detection spells, senses like lifesense, and the "corpse" taking damage from vitality energy still function normally and could reveal the truth without a successful Perception check. Viewing the "corpse" in a mirror's reflection can also reveal the truth, for only the body's shadow reflects. While in sunlight and unconscious, the strigoi loses their resistance to physical damage. If the strigoi takes enough damage that they would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, their body quickly decomposes, and the strigoi is destroyed.

  • Water Revulsion A strigoi cannot cross a significant source of running water (such as a creek, river, or waves on a seashore). A strigoi capable of flight can cross running water provided they approach no closer than 10 feet to the liquid's surface. If forced into running water against their will, the strigoi becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and gains the fleeing condition as long as they remain in the water. At the end of any turn in which the strigoi remains in running water, they must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or be destroyed.

_desc_ko:
모든 스트리고이는 다음 약점을 지닌다:

  • 혐오 스트리고이는 거울이나 밝은 빛의 근원 근처에서 불편함을 느낀다. 거울에는 스트리고이의 그림자만 비치며, 이 때문에 그들은 자신의 진정한 본성이 드러나는 위험을 감수하기보다 주변의 거울을 덮거나 부수려 하는 경우가 많다. 스트리고이는 치켜든 거울이나 밝은 빛의 근원으로부터 10피트 이내로 자발적으로 다가갈 수 없다. 거울이나 광원을 치켜들려면, 생물은 1라운드 동안 상호작용해야 한다(방패 올리기와 유사). 스트리고이가 치켜든 거울이나 광원의 10피트 이내로 비자발적으로 들어오면, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{도주} 상태가 되어, 그 물체로부터 10피트 너머에서 행동을 끝낼 때까지 달아난다. 혐오 대상에 1라운드 노출된 후, 스트리고이는 단일 행동으로 @Check[will|dc:25] 내성을 시도할 수 있으며, 이는 집중 특성을 가진다. 성공 시, [[/gmr 1d6 #Overcome Revulsions Duration]]{1d6 라운드}(대성공 시 1시간) 동안 혐오를 극복한다. 스트리고이는 치켜들지 않은 거울이나 밝은 광원 주위에서 정상적으로 움직일 수 있지만, 그러면 불편함이 생겨 [[/act sense-motive]]를 위한 지각 판정에 성공하면 이를 알아챌 수 있다.

  • 햇빛 직사광선에 노출되면, 스트리고이는 즉시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식} 상태가 되어 땅에 쓰러진다. 그들은 죽은 것처럼 보인다: 숨을 쉬지 않고, 체온이 주변과 일치하며, 통증이나 다른 자극에 반응하지 않는다. 스트리고이의 반사 DC에 대한 @Check[perception|against:reflex] 판정에 성공하면 이상 하나를 알아챌 수 있다: 그들의 "죽은" 몸이 드리우는 그림자가 살짝 움직이며 변하고, 가장자리가 뒤틀리며 활동한다. 특정 탐지 주문, 생명감지 같은 감각, 그리고 "시체"가 활력 에너지로 피해를 받는 것은 여전히 정상적으로 작동하여 지각 판정 성공 없이도 진실을 드러낼 수 있다. "시체"를 거울의 반사로 보는 것도 진실을 드러낼 수 있는데, 몸의 그림자만 비치기 때문이다. 햇빛 속에서 무의식 상태인 동안, 스트리고이는 물리적 피해에 대한 저항을 잃는다. 스트리고이가 생명점 0으로 줄어들 만큼의 피해를 받으면, 그 몸은 빠르게 분해되고 스트리고이는 파괴된다.

  • 물 혐오 스트리고이는 상당한 규모의 흐르는 물(개울, 강, 또는 해안의 파도 등)을 건널 수 없다. 비행이 가능한 스트리고이는 액체 표면으로부터 10피트보다 가까이 접근하지 않는 한 흐르는 물을 건널 수 있다. 의지에 반해 흐르는 물속으로 몰리면, 스트리고이는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 2} 상태가 되고 물속에 머무는 동안 도주 상태를 얻는다. 스트리고이가 흐르는 물속에 머무는 모든 턴이 끝날 때, @Check[flat|dc:5]에 성공해야 하며, 그러지 못하면 파괴된다.

name: (Martial Artist) Constant Feint Stance

description.value: This stance option replaces a different Stance Shift option (usually Secure Grapple Stance). +2 to attempts to [[/act feint]]. If the mixed martial artist rolls a critical failure to Feint, they get a failure instead. If they successfully Feint, they can use Stance Shift as a free action. Unlike other stances, in this stance the mixed martial artist can't make Strikes.

If the mixed martial artist rolls a critical failure to Feint, they get a failure instead. If they successfully Feint, they can use Stance Shift as a free action. Unlike other stances, in this stance the mixed martial artist can't make Strikes.
_desc_ko: 이 자세 선택지는 다른 자세 전환 선택지(보통 확실한 붙잡기 자세)를 대체한다. [[/act feint]] 시도에 +2. 혼합 무술가가 기만 동작에 대실패를 굴리면, 대신 실패로 처리된다. 기만 동작에 성공하면, 자유 행동으로 자세 전환을 사용할 수 있다. 다른 자세와 달리, 이 자세에서 혼합 무술가는 타격을 할 수 없다.

name: (Bulwark) Serpentstone Breath

description.value:
The bulwark breathes a @Template[cone|distance:60] of green gas. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed,inflicts:petrified] save. The bulwark can't use Serpentstone Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Serpentstone Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature's body hardens, causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns.

Critical Failure The creature becomes petrified permanently.

_desc_ko:
불워크는 @Template[cone|distance:60]의 녹색 가스를 내뿜는다. 그 지역의 각 생물은 @Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed,inflicts:petrified] 내성을 시도해야 한다. 불워크는 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Serpentstone Breath]]{1d4 라운드} 동안 뱀돌 브레스를 다시 사용할 수 없다.

대성공 생물은 영향받지 않는다.

성공 생물의 몸이 굳어져 1라운드 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태가 된다.

실패 생물은 1분 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{석화} 상태가 된다. 자신의 각 턴이 끝날 때 새로 내성을 시도할 수 있다.

대실패 생물은 영구히 석화 상태가 된다.

name: (Melfesh Monster) Corpse Bomb

description.value: The Melfesh Monster injects a creature's corpse with spores over the course of 10 minutes, priming it to explode. These spores last 1 day, and the Melfesh Monster can only have three corpses primed at a time; if it primes another, the oldest corpse bomb deactivates harmlessly. Creatures that succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:21|name:Notice Corpse Bomb|traits:action:seek,action:investigate,secret] check while Seeking or Investigating notice a corpse bomb's explosive nature. Creatures can attempt to disarm a corpse bomb with a @Check[nature|dc:21|name:Disable Corpse Bomb (Nature)|traits:action:disable-a-device], @Check[survival|dc:21|name:Disable Corpse Bomb (Survival)|traits:action:disable-a-device], or @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Disable Corpse Bomb (Thievery)|traits:action:disable-a-device] check to Disable a Device. A corpse bomb explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:10] if a creature comes within 5 feet or if the Melfesh Monster detonates it as a single action, which it can use once per round. This deals @Damage[2d8[fire],2d8[poison]|options:area-damage]{2d8 fire and 2d8 poison damage} (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|name:Corpse Bomb|options:area-effect] save) and leaves a lingering, 10-foot-radius spore cloud. A creature that enters or begins its turn within the cloud inhales spores, which remain in its body for 1 minute. This ability replaces Spore Cloud.

name: (Vampire, Strigoi) Drink Essence

description.value:
Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the strigoi's reach

Effect The strigoi sinks their fangs into the targeted creature to drink its blood and draw out its vital essence. This requires an @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC if the creature is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and the strigoi regains HP equal to 10% of their maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Essence from a creature that's already drained or stupefied doesn't restore any HP but increases either the creature's drained condition value or its stupefied condition value by 1 (whichever value is lesser is increased; if both values are equal, then the strigoi chooses which condition to increase the value of).

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:20] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.

A victim's stupefied condition decreases by 1 per day after performing daily preparations. If the daily preparations are done in full sunlight, the stupefied condition is removed entirely.

_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{마비}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식}, 또는 동의한 생물이 스트리고이의 간격 이내에 있다

효과 스트리고이는 대상 생물에게 송곳니를 박아 그 피를 마시고 생명의 정수를 뽑아낸다. 생물이 붙잡힘 상태라면 그 생물의 인내 DC에 대한 @Check[athletics|against:fortitude] 판정이 필요하며, 다른 조건들에 대해서는 자동으로 이루어진다. 그 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{생명력 고갈 1}과 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1} 상태가 되고, 스트리고이는 자신의 최대 HP의 10%에 해당하는 HP를 회복하며, 초과분은 임시 생명점으로 얻는다. 이미 생명력 고갈이나 멍함 상태인 생물로부터 정수를 흡취하면 HP를 전혀 회복하지 못하지만, 그 생물의 생명력 고갈 값이나 멍청함 값 중 하나를 1 증가시킨다(둘 중 더 작은 값이 증가한다; 두 값이 같으면 스트리고이가 어느 조건의 값을 증가시킬지 선택한다).

피해자의 생명력 고갈 조건은 주당 1씩 감소한다. 성공적인 @Check[medicine|dc:20] 판정과 충분한 혈액 또는 헌혈자가 필요한 수혈은 10분 후 생명력 고갈 값을 1 감소시킨다.

피해자의 멍청함 조건은 일일 준비를 수행한 후 하루당 1씩 감소한다. 일일 준비를 완전한 햇빛 속에서 하면, 멍청함 조건이 완전히 제거된다.

name: (Skeleton) Nimble

description.value: The skeleton is particularly fast and nimble. Its land Speed increases by 10 feet and it has a climb Speed of 20 feet. In addition, it gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.wCnsRCHvtZkZTmO0]{Nimble Dodge} reaction.

_desc_en: The skeleton is particularly fast and nimble. Its land Speed increases by 10 feet and it has a climb Speed of 20 feet. In addition, it gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.wCnsRCHvtZkZTmO0]{Nimble Dodge} reaction.
_desc_ko: 이 스켈레톤은 특히 빠르고 날렵하다. 지상 이동 속도가 10피트 증가하고 20피트의 등반 속도를 가진다. 또한, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.wCnsRCHvtZkZTmO0]{날렵한 회피} 반응을 얻는다.

name: (Beheaded) Giant

description.value: A beheaded created from the head of a giant is a Medium creature, gaining 2 levels and one or more additional beheaded abilities.

_desc_en: A beheaded created from the head of a giant is a Medium creature, gaining 2 levels and one or more additional beheaded abilities.
_desc_ko: 거인의 머리로 만들어진 참수체는 중형 생물이며, 2레벨과 하나 이상의 추가 참수체 능력을 얻는다.

name: (Adamantine Dragon) Cratering Smash

description.value:
The dragon smashes itself into the ground, cratering the earth in a 10-foot deep, 60-foot wide emanation. Creatures in the area are thrown into the air and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:prone] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Avalanche Breath.

Critical Success The creature lands on its feet.

Success The creature lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Failure The creature lands prone and takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[untyped]]{1d6 damage per every two levels} of the dragon.

Critical Failure As failure, and the dragon can make a jaws Strike against the creature as a free action. It can only attack one creature that critically failed its save.

_desc_en:
The dragon smashes itself into the ground, cratering the earth in a 10-foot deep, 60-foot wide emanation. Creatures in the area are thrown into the air and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:prone] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Avalanche Breath.

Critical Success The creature lands on its feet.

Success The creature lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Failure The creature lands prone and takes @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[untyped]]{1d6 damage per every two levels} of the dragon.

Critical Failure As failure, and the dragon can make a jaws Strike against the creature as a free action. It can only attack one creature that critically failed its save.
_desc_ko:
드래곤은 자신을 땅에 내리쳐, 깊이 10피트, 너비 60피트의 방출 범위로 대지에 분화구를 만든다. 그 지역의 생물은 공중으로 튕겨 올라가며 드래곤의 눈사태 브레스와 같은 DC로 @Check[reflex|dc:|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:prone] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

대성공 생물은 두 발로 착지한다.

성공 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{넘어짐} 상태로 착지한다.

실패 생물은 넘어짐 상태로 착지하고 드래곤 레벨 2당 @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[untyped]]{1d6 피해}를 받는다.

대실패 실패와 같으며, 드래곤은 자유 행동으로 그 생물을 상대로 턱 타격을 할 수 있다. 내성에 대실패한 생물 하나만 공격할 수 있다.

name: (Coral Dragon) Grasping Waves

description.value: The dragon conjures five watery tentacles from unoccupied water-filled squares of their choice within 30 feet and attempts a single @Check[athletics|against:fortitude|options:inflicts:grabbed] check against the Fortitude DC of every creature adjacent to a tentacle and no more than 10 feet above the water's surface. On a success, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} (Escape DC equal to the DC of the dragon's Hydraulic Breath). On a critical success, or a success against a creature already grabbed, the target is dragged below the surface and begins to drown. All tentacles disappear at the end of the dragon's next turn unless the effect is Sustained and a new Athletics check is rolled for all existing tentacles.

_desc_en: The dragon conjures five watery tentacles from unoccupied water-filled squares of their choice within 30 feet and attempts a single @Check[athletics|against:fortitude|options:inflicts:grabbed] check against the Fortitude DC of every creature adjacent to a tentacle and no more than 10 feet above the water's surface. On a success, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} (Escape DC equal to the DC of the dragon's Hydraulic Breath). On a critical success, or a success against a creature already grabbed, the target is dragged below the surface and begins to drown. All tentacles disappear at the end of the dragon's next turn unless the effect is Sustained and a new Athletics check is rolled for all existing tentacles.
_desc_ko: 드래곤은 30피트 이내에서 자신이 선택한, 점유되지 않은 물이 찬 칸에서 다섯 개의 물 촉수를 소환하고, 촉수에 인접하며 물 표면으로부터 10피트 이내 높이에 있는 모든 생물의 인내 DC에 대해 단일 @Check[athletics|against:fortitude|options:inflicts:grabbed] 판정을 시도한다. 성공 시, 그 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기} 상태가 된다(탈출 DC는 드래곤의 수압 브레스 DC와 같음). 대성공 시, 또는 이미 붙잡힘 상태인 생물에 대한 성공 시, 대상은 수면 아래로 끌려 내려가 익사하기 시작한다. 모든 촉수는 효과가 유지되어 기존의 모든 촉수에 대해 새로운 운동 판정을 굴리지 않는 한, 드래곤의 다음 턴이 끝날 때 사라진다.

name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Basic) Vetalarana Vulnerabilities

description.value:
All vetalaranas possess the following weaknesses.

  • Barred Senses A vetalarana can't see or sense through force effects or cold iron, and their mind can't penetrate force effects or cold iron. Such barriers can prevent the transference of a vetalarana's mind through Mental Rebirth.
  • Revulsion A vetalarana delights in consuming memories and secrets, and is disgusted by those who share such sensitive tidbits openly. A vetalarana can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a creature loudly voicing their intimate personal secrets or most cherished memories aloud. Speaking such information aloud with conviction is a single action that has the auditory, concentrate, and linguistic traits, and protects the creature until the start of its next turn. A vetalarana that involuntarily comes within 10 feet of a creature sharing such information gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition until they're 10 feet or farther from the creature. After 1 round of being exposed to the secrets of a creature, a vetalarana can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Vulnerable to Brain Destruction A vetalarana whose brain has been destroyed, or is reduced to 0 HP while unable to take mental actions, can't use Mental Rebirth.

_desc_en:
All vetalaranas possess the following weaknesses.

  • Barred Senses A vetalarana can't see or sense through force effects or cold iron, and their mind can't penetrate force effects or cold iron. Such barriers can prevent the transference of a vetalarana's mind through Mental Rebirth.
  • Revulsion A vetalarana delights in consuming memories and secrets, and is disgusted by those who share such sensitive tidbits openly. A vetalarana can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a creature loudly voicing their intimate personal secrets or most cherished memories aloud. Speaking such information aloud with conviction is a single action that has the auditory, concentrate, and linguistic traits, and protects the creature until the start of its next turn. A vetalarana that involuntarily comes within 10 feet of a creature sharing such information gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition until they're 10 feet or farther from the creature. After 1 round of being exposed to the secrets of a creature, a vetalarana can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Vulnerable to Brain Destruction A vetalarana whose brain has been destroyed, or is reduced to 0 HP while unable to take mental actions, can't use Mental Rebirth.
_desc_ko:
모든 베탈라라나는 다음 약점을 지닌다.

  • 차단된 감각 베탈라라나는 힘 효과나 냉철을 통해 보거나 감지할 수 없으며, 그들의 정신은 힘 효과나 냉철을 관통할 수 없다. 그러한 장벽은 정신 재탄생을 통한 베탈라라나 정신의 전이를 막을 수 있다.
  • 혐오 베탈라라나는 기억과 비밀을 삼키는 것을 즐기며, 그러한 민감한 것들을 공공연히 나누는 자들을 역겨워한다. 베탈라라나는 자신의 은밀한 개인적 비밀이나 가장 소중한 기억을 큰 소리로 말하는 생물로부터 10피트 이내로 자발적으로 다가갈 수 없다. 그러한 정보를 확신을 담아 큰 소리로 말하는 것은 청각, 집중, 언어 특성을 가진 단일 행동이며, 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 그 생물을 보호한다. 그러한 정보를 나누는 생물로부터 10피트 이내로 비자발적으로 들어온 베탈라라나는 그 생물로부터 10피트 이상 떨어질 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{도주} 상태를 얻는다. 어떤 생물의 비밀에 1라운드 노출된 후, 베탈라라나는 단일 행동으로 @Check[will|dc:25] 내성을 시도할 수 있으며, 이는 집중 특성을 가진다. 성공 시, [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 라운드}(대성공 시 1시간) 동안 혐오를 극복한다.
  • 뇌 파괴에 취약 뇌가 파괴되었거나, 정신적 행동을 취할 수 없는 상태에서 HP 0으로 줄어든 베탈라라나는 정신 재탄생을 사용할 수 없다.

name: (Vampire, Vrykolakas Master) Pestilential Aura

description.value: 5 feet. Creatures beginning their turn in the area while the vrykolakas is in its true form are exposed to bubonic plague.

_desc_en: 5 feet. Creatures beginning their turn in the area while the vrykolakas is in its true form are exposed to bubonic plague.
_desc_ko: 5피트. 브리콜라카스가 진정한 형태일 때 이 지역에서 턴을 시작하는 생물은 흑사병에 노출된다.

name: (Vampire, True) Mist Escape

description.value:
Trigger The vampire is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The vampire uses Turn to Mist. They can take move actions to move toward its coffin even though it's at 0 HP. While at 0 HP in this form, the vampire is unaffected by further damage.

They automatically returns to its corporeal form, unconscious, if they reaches their coffin or after 2 hours, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Trigger The vampire is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The vampire uses Turn to Mist. They can take move actions to move toward its coffin even though it's at 0 HP. While at 0 HP in this form, the vampire is unaffected by further damage.

They automatically returns to its corporeal form, unconscious, if they reaches their coffin or after 2 hours, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
발동 뱀파이어가 HP 0으로 줄어든다.

효과 뱀파이어는 안개로 변신을 사용한다. HP 0인 상태이지만 이동 행동을 취해 자신의 관을 향해 이동할 수 있다. 이 형태로 HP 0인 동안, 뱀파이어는 추가 피해의 영향을 받지 않는다.

자신의 관에 도달하거나 2시간이 지나면(둘 중 먼저 오는 쪽), 뱀파이어는 자동으로 무의식 상태로 실체 형태로 돌아온다.

name: (Vampire, Vrykolakas Master) Change Shape

description.value: A vrykolakas master can transform into a form resembling the body it had in life, with the effects of humanoid form but with unlimited duration. It loses its fangs and claw Strikes but gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} in this form.

rules.label: Impersonating the Body It Had in Life

_desc_en: A vrykolakas master can transform into a form resembling the body it had in life, with the effects of humanoid form but with unlimited duration. It loses its fangs and claw Strikes but gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} in this form.
_desc_ko: 브리콜라카스 마스터는 생전에 가졌던 몸을 닮은 형태로 변신할 수 있으며, 이는 인간형 형태의 효과를 가지되 지속시간이 무제한이다. 송곳니와 발톱 타격을 잃지만, 이 형태에서 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{위장}을 위한 기만 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻는다.

name: (Risen Nemesis) Fixated Obsession

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect The Risen Nemesis expresses a vengeful interest in a target within 30 feet. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). On failure or critical failure, the Risen Nemesis also gains a +2 status bonus on Strikes and damage rolls against the target until the target or the Risen Nemesis dies, whichever comes first.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Effect The Risen Nemesis expresses a vengeful interest in a target within 30 feet. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). On failure or critical failure, the Risen Nemesis also gains a +2 status bonus on Strikes and damage rolls against the target until the target or the Risen Nemesis dies, whichever comes first.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루에 한 번

효과 부활한 네메시스는 30피트 이내의 대상에 복수심 어린 관심을 표한다. 그 생물은 @Check[will|dc:42] 내성에 성공해야 하며, 그러지 못하면 1분 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1} 상태가 된다(대실패 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 2}). 실패 또는 대실패 시, 부활한 네메시스는 또한 대상 또는 부활한 네메시스가 죽을 때까지(둘 중 먼저 오는 쪽) 그 대상을 상대로 한 타격과 피해 굴림에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

name: (Special Forces) Mounted Marauders

description.value:
These special forces soldiers are mounted. Increase their Speed to 40 feet. While moving on land, this troop ignores difficult terrain.

Effect s that target only animals or humanoids might not work on this troop, subject to GM discretion. Mounted troops can't also have composite bows.

_desc_en:
These special forces soldiers are mounted. Increase their Speed to 40 feet. While moving on land, this troop ignores difficult terrain.

Effect s that target only animals or humanoids might not work on this troop, subject to GM discretion. Mounted troops can't also have composite bows.
_desc_ko:
이 특수 부대 병사들은 탈것을 타고 있다. 이동 속도를 40피트로 증가시킨다. 지상에서 이동하는 동안, 이 부대는 험지를 무시한다.

효과 동물 또는 인간형만을 대상으로 하는 효과는 GM의 재량에 따라 이 부대에 작동하지 않을 수 있다. 기마 부대는 합성궁을 함께 가질 수 없다.

name: (Woodblessed) Tap Planar Gate

description.value:
The woodblessed empowers themself or their next attack.

If the woodblessed's next action is to Stride, is launched off the ground by a suddenly sprouting tree and propelled forward. During this Stride, they have a fly Speed equal to their Speed. If they don't end their movement on a solid surface that can support their weight, they fall.

If the woodblessed's next action is a Strike, the attack sprouts thorns that deal an additional 1d4 persistent bleed damage (1d6 for levels 6–12, 1d10 for levels 13+).

_desc_en:
The woodblessed empowers themself or their next attack.

If the woodblessed's next action is to Stride, is launched off the ground by a suddenly sprouting tree and propelled forward. During this Stride, they have a fly Speed equal to their Speed. If they don't end their movement on a solid surface that can support their weight, they fall.

If the woodblessed's next action is a Strike, the attack sprouts thorns that deal an additional 1d4 persistent bleed damage (1d6 for levels 6–12, 1d10 for levels 13+).
_desc_ko:
숲의 축복받은 자는 자신 또는 자신의 다음 공격을 강화한다.

숲의 축복받은 자의 다음 행동이 보폭이라면, 갑자기 솟아난 나무에 의해 땅에서 튕겨 올라 앞으로 추진된다. 이 보폭 동안, 자신의 이동 속도와 같은 비행 속도를 가진다. 자신의 무게를 지탱할 수 있는 단단한 표면에서 이동을 끝내지 않으면, 추락한다.

숲의 축복받은 자의 다음 행동이 타격이라면, 그 공격에서 가시가 솟아나 추가로 1d4 지속 출혈 피해를 입힌다(6~12레벨은 1d6, 13레벨 이상은 1d10).

name: (Swarm Strider) Swarm Shape

description.value: The swarm strider collapses into a shapeless swarm of their constituent creatures. They drops all items in their possession. In this form, the swarm strider can't use attack actions and can't cast spells, but they can move through areas small enough for their constituent creatures to fit without having to Squeeze. They can use the same action to coalesce from their swarm shape back into their normal form.

_desc_en: The swarm strider collapses into a shapeless swarm of their constituent creatures. They drops all items in their possession. In this form, the swarm strider can't use attack actions and can't cast spells, but they can move through areas small enough for their constituent creatures to fit without having to Squeeze. They can use the same action to coalesce from their swarm shape back into their normal form.
_desc_ko: 군집 보행자는 자신을 구성하는 생물들의 형태 없는 군집으로 무너진다. 소지하고 있던 모든 물품을 떨어뜨린다. 이 형태에서 군집 보행자는 공격 행동을 사용할 수 없고 주문을 시전할 수 없지만, 구성 생물들이 들어갈 수 있을 만큼 작은 지역을 비집기 없이 통과할 수 있다. 같은 행동을 사용해 군집 형태에서 정상 형태로 다시 결집할 수 있다.

name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Noqual)

description.value:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

Noqual The stargut hydra's Strikes and abilities gain a +2 status bonus to damage against creatures with the ability to Cast a Spell.

_desc_en:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

Noqual The stargut hydra's Strikes and abilities gain a +2 status bonus to damage against creatures with the ability to Cast a Spell.
_desc_ko:
각 별창자 히드라는 특정 천상금속을 섭취하고 그 특성을 체내에 흡수한 결과로 최소 하나의 변형을 지닌다.

노쿠알 별창자 히드라의 타격과 능력은 주문 시전 능력을 지닌 생물에 대해 피해에 +2 상태 보너스를 얻는다.

name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Manipulator) Control Comatose

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect The vetalarana manipulator spends 10 minutes to take psychic control of the creatures they've rendered comatose with Drain Thoughts. This has the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} spell, but lasts for up to 6 hours, has a range of 1 mile, and the vetalarana can control a number of comatose victims at a time equal to half the vetalarana's level. A comatose victim can't resist this possession and automatically gets a critical failure on its saving throw against Control Comatose.

As long as a comatose victim is controlled by a vetalarana manipulator in this way, the victim's stupefied and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions are temporarily suppressed.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Effect The vetalarana manipulator spends 10 minutes to take psychic control of the creatures they've rendered comatose with Drain Thoughts. This has the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} spell, but lasts for up to 6 hours, has a range of 1 mile, and the vetalarana can control a number of comatose victims at a time equal to half the vetalarana's level. A comatose victim can't resist this possession and automatically gets a critical failure on its saving throw against Control Comatose.

As long as a comatose victim is controlled by a vetalarana manipulator in this way, the victim's stupefied and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions are temporarily suppressed.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 한 번

효과 베탈라라나 조종자는 10분을 들여 사고 흡수로 혼수상태로 만든 생물들에 대한 정신적 지배를 획득한다. 이는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{빙의} 주문의 효과를 지니지만, 최대 6시간 지속되고 사거리가 1마일이며, 베탈라라나는 자신 레벨의 절반과 같은 수의 혼수상태 희생자를 동시에 지배할 수 있다. 혼수상태 희생자는 이 빙의에 저항할 수 없으며 혼수 지배에 대한 내성 굴림에서 자동으로 대실패한다.

혼수상태 희생자가 이러한 방식으로 베탈라라나 조종자에게 지배받는 동안, 그 희생자의 멍청함 및 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식} 상태는 일시적으로 억제된다.

name: (Skeleton) Bone Powder

description.value:
When the skeleton takes physical damage from a critical hit, one of its bones is pulverized into a fine powder.

All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that breathe take @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] damage (plus an additional 1d6 for every 6 levels the skeleton has).

_desc_en:
When the skeleton takes physical damage from a critical hit, one of its bones is pulverized into a fine powder.

All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that breathe take @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] damage (plus an additional 1d6 for every 6 levels the skeleton has).
_desc_ko:
해골이 대성공 명중으로 물리 피해를 받으면, 그 뼈 중 하나가 고운 가루로 으스러진다.

@Template[emanation|distance:5] 안에서 호흡하는 모든 생물은 @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] 피해를 받는다(해골이 지닌 6레벨마다 1d6 추가).

name: (Ghost) Fetch

description.value:
The ghost creates an illusory double of a creature. The fetch functions as a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature}, except that the ghost doesn't control the fetch, and the spell lasts for [[/r 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours} instead of needing to Sustain the Spell.

The fetch has a rudimentary intelligence and tries to imitate its original (it has a Deception skill value equal to the ghost's highest skill) but comes across as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or vague.

A ghost can have only one fetch at a time. If the creature doubled by the fetch encounters it, the creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure) for as long as they can see the fetch.

_desc_en:
The ghost creates an illusory double of a creature. The fetch functions as a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature}, except that the ghost doesn't control the fetch, and the spell lasts for [[/r 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours} instead of needing to Sustain the Spell.

The fetch has a rudimentary intelligence and tries to imitate its original (it has a Deception skill value equal to the ghost's highest skill) but comes across as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} or vague.

A ghost can have only one fetch at a time. If the creature doubled by the fetch encounters it, the creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure) for as long as they can see the fetch.
_desc_ko:
유령이 어떤 생물의 환영 분신을 만든다. 페치는 2랭크 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{환영 생물}처럼 작동하지만, 유령이 페치를 조종하지 않으며 주문을 유지할 필요 없이 [[/r 1d4 #hours]]{1d4시간} 동안 지속된다.

페치는 원시적인 지능을 지녀 원본을 흉내 내려 하지만(유령의 가장 높은 기술과 같은 기만 기술 값을 지닌다) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란}스럽거나 모호하게 보인다.

유령은 한 번에 하나의 페치만 지닐 수 있다. 페치가 복제한 생물이 그것과 마주치면, 그 생물은 @Check[will|dc:] 내성에 성공해야 하며 실패하면 페치를 볼 수 있는 한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1}(대실패 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 2}) 상태가 된다.

name: (Woodblessed) Reactive Flare

description.value:
Trigger The woodblessed is damaged by a creature within their reach

Effect Distracted by the pain, the woodblessed's concentration slips and splinters erupt from their body as they temporarily lose control of the planar energy within them. Both the triggering creature and the woodblessed take @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage + 1d6 per 2 levels the woodblessed has, with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic] save against the woodblessed's spell DC.

_desc_en:
Trigger The woodblessed is damaged by a creature within their reach

Effect Distracted by the pain, the woodblessed's concentration slips and splinters erupt from their body as they temporarily lose control of the planar energy within them. Both the triggering creature and the woodblessed take @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage + 1d6 per 2 levels the woodblessed has, with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic] save against the woodblessed's spell DC.
_desc_ko:
발동 숲축복받은자가 자신의 간격 내 생물에게 피해를 입음

효과 고통에 정신이 흐트러져 숲축복받은자의 집중이 풀리고, 체내의 이계 에너지에 대한 통제를 일시적으로 잃으면서 몸에서 가시가 돋아난다. 발동시킨 생물과 숲축복받은자 모두 @Damage[1d6[piercing]] 피해 + 숲축복받은자가 지닌 2레벨마다 1d6 피해를 받으며, 숲축복받은자의 주문 DC에 대한 @Check[reflex|dc:|basic] 내성을 굴린다.

name: (Vampire, Vrykolakas Master) Children of the Night

description.value:
The presence of a vrykolakas master inspires savage creatures to crawl forth to do its bidding, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.6wPW2dvpt86Ou6bL]{Rat Swarms}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.x7Aa4Tvr9eBaHryF]{Wargs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Hg7nCvltRBQOiijQ]{Werewolves}, and similar creatures.

The vrykolakas master can give telepathic orders to these creatures within 100 feet, but they can't communicate back.

name_en: (Vampire, Vrykolakas Master) Children of the Night
_desc_en:
The presence of a vrykolakas master inspires savage creatures to crawl forth to do its bidding, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.6wPW2dvpt86Ou6bL]{Rat Swarms}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.x7Aa4Tvr9eBaHryF]{Wargs}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Hg7nCvltRBQOiijQ]{Werewolves}, and similar creatures.

The vrykolakas master can give telepathic orders to these creatures within 100 feet, but they can't communicate back.
_desc_ko:
브리콜라카스 주인의 존재는 야만적인 생물들이 그 명령을 따르도록 기어 나오게 하며, 여기에는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.6wPW2dvpt86Ou6bL]{쥐 무리}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.x7Aa4Tvr9eBaHryF]{와그}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Hg7nCvltRBQOiijQ]{인간늑대} 및 유사한 생물이 포함된다.

브리콜라카스 주인은 100피트 내의 이러한 생물들에게 텔레파시로 명령을 내릴 수 있지만, 그들은 되받아 소통할 수 없다.

name: (Melfesh Monster) Torrential Advance

description.value: The Melfesh Monster dissolves into a mass of fungal threads and surges forward. It @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]{Tramples} (Medium or smaller, limb, @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|name:Trample] save), leaving a spore cloud in the squares through which it moves that last until the end of its next turn. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the cloud inhales spores and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21|name:Torrential Advance] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). This ability replaces Envelop and Spore Cloud.

This ability replaces Envelop and Spore Cloud.
_desc_ko: 멜페쉬 괴물이 균사 다발로 녹아내려 앞으로 밀려간다. 이는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]{짓밟기}(중형 이하, 사지, @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|name:Trample] 내성)를 사용하며, 이동한 칸에 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되는 포자 구름을 남긴다. 그 구름에 들어가거나 그 안에서 턴을 시작하는 생물은 포자를 흡입하고 @Check[fortitude|dc:21|name:Torrential Advance] 내성에 성공해야 하며 실패하면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1}(대실패 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 2}) 상태가 된다. 이 능력은 감싸기와 포자 구름을 대체한다.

name: (Mythic) Remove a Condition

description.value:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect The creature ends one condition affecting it.

_desc_en:
Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect The creature ends one condition affecting it.
_desc_ko:
비용 신화 점수 1

효과 생물이 자신에게 영향을 미치는 상태 하나를 끝낸다.

name: (Lich) Pillage Mind

description.value:
Trigger The lich deals damage with their hand Strike

Effect The lich pulls a memory or thought from the target's mind. The lich Recalls Information with a skill of their choice, using the target's bonus with the skill instead of their own. If there's a very specific piece of information the lich hopes to uncover, and the target knows that information, the target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:] save to keep it secret. On a critical success, the target can give the lich faulty information instead.

_desc_en:
Trigger The lich deals damage with their hand Strike

Effect The lich pulls a memory or thought from the target's mind. The lich Recalls Information with a skill of their choice, using the target's bonus with the skill instead of their own. If there's a very specific piece of information the lich hopes to uncover, and the target knows that information, the target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:] save to keep it secret. On a critical success, the target can give the lich faulty information instead.
_desc_ko:
발동 리치가 손 타격으로 피해를 입힘

효과 리치가 대상의 정신에서 기억이나 생각을 끌어낸다. 리치는 자신이 선택한 기술로 정보를 회상하며, 그 기술에 대해 자신의 보너스 대신 대상의 보너스를 사용한다. 리치가 밝혀내고자 하는 매우 구체적인 정보가 있고 대상이 그 정보를 알고 있다면, 대상은 @Check[will|dc:] 내성을 시도해 그것을 비밀로 지킬 수 있다. 대성공 시, 대상은 대신 리치에게 거짓 정보를 줄 수 있다.

name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Hulking Form

description.value: Increase the mutant's size by one category. Decrease their AC by 1, increase their HP by 1/10 their normal maximum HP, and increase the reach of all their melee Strikes by 5 feet.

_desc_en: Increase the mutant's size by one category. Decrease their AC by 1, increase their HP by 1/10 their normal maximum HP, and increase the reach of all their melee Strikes by 5 feet.
_desc_ko: 돌연변이의 크기를 한 등급 증가시킨다. AC를 1 감소시키고, HP를 평소 최대 HP의 1/10만큼 증가시키며, 모든 근접 타격의 간격을 5피트 증가시킨다.

name: (Cryptid, Experimental) Clobber

description.value: The experimental cryptid Strikes a creature. On a hit, the creature is pushed 5 feet (10 feet on a critical hit) and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If this causes the creature to collide with a solid object, the creature takes an additional 1d10 untyped damage. If the experimental cryptid is at least 5th level, this Strike deals one additional weapon damage die of damage, and if the experimental cryptid is at least 15th level, this Strike deals two additional weapon damage dice of damage.

If this causes the creature to collide with a solid object, the creature takes an additional 1d10 untyped damage. If the experimental cryptid is at least 5th level, this Strike deals one additional weapon damage die of damage, and if the experimental cryptid is at least 15th level, this Strike deals two additional weapon damage dice of damage.
_desc_ko: 실험체 크립티드가 어떤 생물을 타격한다. 명중 시, 그 생물은 5피트(대성공 시 10피트) 밀려나고 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{넘어짐} 상태가 된다. 이로 인해 생물이 단단한 물체와 충돌하면, 그 생물은 추가로 1d10 무유형 피해를 받는다. 실험체 크립티드가 최소 5레벨이면 이 타격은 추가로 무기 피해 주사위 1개의 피해를 입히고, 최소 15레벨이면 추가로 무기 피해 주사위 2개의 피해를 입힌다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Divine Innate Spells

description.value: The nosferatu can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul} (heightened to half their level rounded up) three times per day and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} twice per day as a divine innate spell. They use a high DC for their level.

_desc_en: The nosferatu can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{Telekinetic Haul} (heightened to half their level rounded up) three times per day and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} twice per day as a divine innate spell. They use a high DC for their level.
_desc_ko: 노스페라투는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tpLTLbJUrYcMWGld]{염력 운반}(자신 레벨의 절반을 올림하여 강화)을 하루 세 번, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{흡혈 방혈}을 하루 두 번 신성 선천 주문으로 시전할 수 있다. 자신 레벨에 대한 높은 DC를 사용한다.

name: (Cryptid, Experimental) Power Surge

description.value:
The experimental cryptid draws on its augmentations to empower its attacks. It attempts a @Check[flat|dc:5]. On a success, the experimental cryptid deals 1d6 additional damage with its Strikes until the end of its turn. On a failure, the experimental cryptid takes that much damage instead. The damage and traits for Power Surge are the same as those of Energy Wave.

This additional damage increases to 2d6 if the experimental cryptid is 9th level or higher, 3d6 if the experimental cryptid is 15th level or higher, and 4d6 if the experimental cryptid is 18th level or higher.

_desc_en:
The experimental cryptid draws on its augmentations to empower its attacks. It attempts a @Check[flat|dc:5]. On a success, the experimental cryptid deals 1d6 additional damage with its Strikes until the end of its turn. On a failure, the experimental cryptid takes that much damage instead. The damage and traits for Power Surge are the same as those of Energy Wave.

This additional damage increases to 2d6 if the experimental cryptid is 9th level or higher, 3d6 if the experimental cryptid is 15th level or higher, and 4d6 if the experimental cryptid is 18th level or higher.
_desc_ko:
실험체 크립티드가 자신의 증강 장치를 이용해 공격에 힘을 싣는다. @Check[flat|dc:5]를 시도한다. 성공 시, 실험체 크립티드는 자신의 턴이 끝날 때까지 타격으로 1d6 추가 피해를 입힌다. 실패 시, 실험체 크립티드는 대신 그만큼의 피해를 받는다. 동력 폭주의 피해와 특성은 에너지 파동의 것과 동일하다.

이 추가 피해는 실험체 크립티드가 9레벨 이상이면 2d6, 15레벨 이상이면 3d6, 18레벨 이상이면 4d6으로 증가한다.

name: (Ghost) Dreamwalker

description.value:
Anyone who meets the ghost or visits its bound site can become subject to this effect. The first time the subject sleeps after their ghostly encounter, they're targeted by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} spell, with the nightmares being somehow related to the ghost.

Most often this means that the subject relives the ghost's last moments alive, but there are other possibilities. If the ghost wishes, it can manipulate the dreams to send messages or even hold entire conversations with dreamers.

_desc_en:
Anyone who meets the ghost or visits its bound site can become subject to this effect. The first time the subject sleeps after their ghostly encounter, they're targeted by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} spell, with the nightmares being somehow related to the ghost.

Most often this means that the subject relives the ghost's last moments alive, but there are other possibilities. If the ghost wishes, it can manipulate the dreams to send messages or even hold entire conversations with dreamers.
_desc_ko:
유령을 만나거나 그것이 얽매인 장소를 방문한 자는 누구든 이 효과의 대상이 될 수 있다. 대상이 그 유령과 마주친 후 처음으로 잠들 때, 그들은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{악몽} 주문의 대상이 되며, 그 악몽은 어떤 식으로든 유령과 관련되어 있다.

대개 이는 대상이 유령이 살아 있던 마지막 순간을 다시 겪는 것을 의미하지만, 다른 가능성도 있다. 유령이 원한다면, 꿈을 조작해 메시지를 보내거나 심지어 꿈꾸는 자와 전체 대화를 나눌 수도 있다.

name: (Ghost) Rejuvenation

description.value: When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

_desc_en: When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.
_desc_ko: 유령이 파괴되면, [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4일} 후 자신이 얽매인 장소 내에서 완전히 치유된 채 다시 형성된다. 유령은 누군가가 그 존재의 이유를 밝혀내고 그 영혼이 안식하지 못하게 막는 것을 바로잡아야만 영구히 파괴될 수 있다.

name: (Blackfrost Dead) Shattering Death

description.value: When the blackfrost dead is destroyed, its body shatters like brittle ice, filling the air around it with a cloud of frigid, razor-sharp ice shards. Creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[1d8[cold]|options:area-damage] per level of the blackfrost dead (minimum 3d8), with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:bleed] save. Creatures that critically fail this save also take @Damage[1d6[bleed]].

_desc_en: When the blackfrost dead is destroyed, its body shatters like brittle ice, filling the air around it with a cloud of frigid, razor-sharp ice shards. Creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[1d8[cold]|options:area-damage] per level of the blackfrost dead (minimum 3d8), with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:bleed] save. Creatures that critically fail this save also take @Damage[1d6[bleed]].
_desc_ko: 흑서리 망자가 파괴되면, 그 몸이 부서지기 쉬운 얼음처럼 산산조각 나며 주변 공기를 차갑고 면도날처럼 날카로운 얼음 파편 구름으로 채운다. @Template[emanation|distance:10] 안의 생물은 흑서리 망자의 레벨당 @Damage[1d8[cold]|options:area-damage] 피해(최소 3d8)를 받으며, @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:bleed] 내성을 굴린다. 이 내성에 대실패한 생물은 추가로 @Damage[1d6[bleed]] 피해도 받는다.

name: (Zombie) Disgusting Pustules

description.value:
The zombie is covered in pustules that rupture when it takes any piercing damage or any critical hit.

Adjacent creatures are hit with vile fluid, causing them to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Disgusting Pustules] save against the moderate spell DC for the zombie's level.

_desc_en:
The zombie is covered in pustules that rupture when it takes any piercing damage or any critical hit.

Adjacent creatures are hit with vile fluid, causing them to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Disgusting Pustules] save against the moderate spell DC for the zombie's level.
_desc_ko:
좀비는 관통 피해나 대성공 명중을 받으면 터지는 농포로 뒤덮여 있다.

인접한 생물은 역겨운 체액을 뒤집어쓰며, 좀비 레벨에 대한 중간 주문 DC에 대해 @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Disgusting Pustules] 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{구역질 1} 상태가 된다.

name: (Nemesis) Explosive Blast

description.value:
Frequency twice per day

Effect Nemesis causes a @Template[burst|distance:20] of explosive energy at a range of up to 200 feet. Choose from acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. Explosive Blast gains that trait, and creatures caught in the area take @Damage[14d6[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.damage]|options:area-damage] damage of that energy type (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] save).

_desc_en:
Frequency twice per day

Effect Nemesis causes a @Template[burst|distance:20] of explosive energy at a range of up to 200 feet. Choose from acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. Explosive Blast gains that trait, and creatures caught in the area take @Damage[14d6[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.damage]|options:area-damage] damage of that energy type (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] save).
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 두 번

효과 네메시스가 최대 200피트 거리에 @Template[burst|distance:20]의 폭발성 에너지를 일으킨다. 산성, 냉기, 전기, 화염, 음파 중에서 선택한다. 폭발성 방출은 그 특성을 얻으며, 범위에 걸린 생물은 그 에너지 유형의 @Damage[14d6[@item.flags.system.rulesSelections.damage]|options:area-damage] 피해를 받는다(@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] 내성).

name: (Visitant) Roar

description.value:
The visitant lets out a loud and horrifying roar. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:100]{100 feet} must attempt at a @Check[will|dc:|name:Roar] save.

No matter the result, affected creatures are then temporarily immune to the effect for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

publication.title: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

_desc_en:
The visitant lets out a loud and horrifying roar. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:100]{100 feet} must attempt at a @Check[will|dc:|name:Roar] save.

No matter the result, affected creatures are then temporarily immune to the effect for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.
_desc_ko:
방문자가 크고 소름 끼치는 포효를 내지른다. @Template[emanation|distance:100]{100피트} 내의 각 생물은 @Check[will|dc:|name:Roar] 내성을 시도해야 한다.

결과와 관계없이, 영향받은 생물은 그 후 1분 동안 이 효과에 일시적으로 면역이 된다.

대성공 생물이 영향받지 않는다.

성공 생물이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 1} 상태가 된다.

실패 생물이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 2} 상태가 된다.

대실패 생물이 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{공포 3} 상태가 된다.

name: (Zombie, Shock) Electromechanical Phasing

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect The shock zombie activates its electromechanical components and begins phasing in and out of reality. The shock zombie casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker} as a 4th-rank divine innate spell.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Effect The shock zombie activates its electromechanical components and begins phasing in and out of reality. The shock zombie casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker} as a 4th-rank divine innate spell.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 한 번

효과 충격 좀비가 전기기계 부품을 작동시켜 현실을 넘나들며 위상변이하기 시작한다. 충격 좀비는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{점멸}을 4랭크 신성 선천 주문으로 시전한다.

name: (Secret Society) Prepared Diversion

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The secret society member has fellow members in all sorts of places, ready to make a distraction to help them duck from sight or make a quick attack against their foe. The secret society member either Creates a Diversion or Feints. If they [[/act create-a-diversion]], it doesn't gain either the auditory, linguistic, or manipulate trait (since someone else has provided the diversion), and onlookers who have already been diverted by the secret society member don't receive a +4 circumstance bonus against the attempt. If they [[/act feint]], they don't need to be in melee reach of their target, and the benefit applies to both melee and ranged attacks against their target.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The secret society member has fellow members in all sorts of places, ready to make a distraction to help them duck from sight or make a quick attack against their foe. The secret society member either Creates a Diversion or Feints. If they [[/act create-a-diversion]], it doesn't gain either the auditory, linguistic, or manipulate trait (since someone else has provided the diversion), and onlookers who have already been diverted by the secret society member don't receive a +4 circumstance bonus against the attempt. If they [[/act feint]], they don't need to be in melee reach of their target, and the benefit applies to both melee and ranged attacks against their target.
_desc_ko:
빈도 한 시간에 한 번

효과 비밀 결사 조직원은 온갖 곳에 동료를 두고 있으며, 그들이 시선을 피해 몸을 숨기거나 적에게 재빠른 공격을 가하도록 돕는 교란을 만들 준비가 되어 있다. 비밀 결사 조직원은 교란 유발 또는 기만 동작 중 하나를 행한다. [[/act create-a-diversion]]를 하면, 그것은 청각, 언어, 조작 특성 중 어느 것도 얻지 않으며(다른 누군가가 교란을 제공했으므로), 이미 비밀 결사 조직원에게 교란당한 적이 있는 목격자는 그 시도에 대해 +4 상황 보너스를 받지 않는다. [[/act feint]]를 하면, 대상의 근접 간격 내에 있을 필요가 없으며, 그 이점은 대상에 대한 근접 및 원거리 공격 모두에 적용된다.

name: (Risen Nemesis) Pained Retribution

description.value: The Risen Nemesis demands the PCs see how they have wronged them. All PCs within @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} of the Risen Nemesis must attempt a @Check[will|dc:42] save. Regardless of the outcome, the PCs become temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours. On failure, the PCs are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by invisible chains of guilt that only they can see ([[/act escape dc=42]]). On a critical failure, the PC is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute as they hesitate from a guilty conscience.

_desc_en: The Risen Nemesis demands the PCs see how they have wronged them. All PCs within @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} of the Risen Nemesis must attempt a @Check[will|dc:42] save. Regardless of the outcome, the PCs become temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours. On failure, the PCs are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by invisible chains of guilt that only they can see ([[/act escape dc=42]]). On a critical failure, the PC is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute as they hesitate from a guilty conscience.
_desc_ko: 부활한 네메시스가 PC들에게 자신들이 그에게 어떤 잘못을 저질렀는지 보라고 요구한다. 부활한 네메시스의 @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{30피트} 내의 모든 PC는 @Check[will|dc:42] 내성을 시도해야 한다. 결과와 관계없이, PC들은 24시간 동안 이 능력에 일시적으로 면역이 된다. 실패 시, PC들은 자신들만이 볼 수 있는 죄책감의 보이지 않는 사슬에 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제}된다([[/act escape dc=42]]). 대실패 시, PC는 죄책감에 망설이며 1분 동안 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{둔화 1} 상태도 된다.

name: (Path Maiden) Vengeful Frenzy

description.value: The path maiden targets a creature within 60 feet that she can see. The target must attempt a Will save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of its next turn, but it can't attack path maidens or itself as the result of this confusion.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the end of its next turn, but it can't attack path maidens or itself as the result of this confusion.
_desc_ko: 길의 처녀가 자신이 볼 수 있는 60피트 내의 생물을 대상으로 삼는다. 대상은 길의 처녀의 주문 DC에 대해 의지 내성을 시도해야 한다. 실패 시, 대상은 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{혼란} 상태가 되지만, 이 혼란의 결과로 길의 처녀들이나 자기 자신을 공격할 수는 없다.

name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Manipulator) Drain Thoughts

description.value:
Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vetalarana's reach

Effect The vetalarana seizes a creature and consumes its memories. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical success), and the vetalarana regains HP equal to 10% of the vetalarana's maximum HP, gaining any excess as temporary Hit Points. Draining Thoughts from a creature that is already stupefied doesn't restore any HP to the vetalarana but increases the victim's stupefied value by 1. Additionally, the vetalarana views one of the victim's memories. The vetalarana manipulator can choose to alter, enhance, or erase the memory they view as a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FhOaQDTSnsY7tiam]{Rewrite Memory} spell.

A victim's stupefied condition value decreases by 1 every week.

A victim that becomes stupefied 5 in this way is rendered comatose, becoming permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. As long as the vetalarana lives, a comatose victim can't regain consciousness, and its stupefied condition doesn't decrease.

_desc_en:

_desc_ko:
요구조건 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{조이기}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{마비}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{억제}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{무의식} 상태이거나 자발적인 생물이 베탈라라나의 간격 내에 있음

효과 베탈라라나가 어떤 생물을 붙잡아 그 기억을 소비한다. 희생자가 붙잡힘 상태라면 희생자의 건강 DC에 대한 @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] 판정이 필요하며, 다른 상태 중 하나라면 자동으로 성공한다. 희생자는 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 1}(대성공 시 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{멍함 2}) 상태가 되고, 베탈라라나는 자신의 최대 HP의 10%와 같은 HP를 회복하며, 초과분은 임시 히트 포인트로 얻는다. 이미 멍함 상태인 생물에게서 사고를 흡수하면 베탈라라나의 HP를 회복시키지 않지만 희생자의 멍청함 값을 1 증가시킨다. 추가로, 베탈라라나는 희생자의 기억 하나를 본다. 베탈라라나 조종자는 자신이 본 기억을 4랭크 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FhOaQDTSnsY7tiam]{기억 재작성} 주문처럼 변경, 강화 또는 삭제하기로 선택할 수 있다.

name: (Vampire, True) Create Servitor

description.value:
If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Drink Blood, the vampire can turn this victim into a vampire servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights.

A vampiric servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if a vampire controls too many vampiric servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than the vampire that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a @Check[will|defense:will] saving throw against the vampire's Will DC.

뱀파이어 종복은 창조자에게 복종하도록 강요받지만, 뱀파이어가 한 번에 너무 많은 뱀파이어 종복을 지배하거나(GM이 판단), 종복이 자신을 창조한 뱀파이어보다 높은 레벨이면, 의지가 강한 종복은 뱀파이어의 의지 DC에 대한 @Check[will|defense:will] 내성 굴림에 성공해 스스로를 해방시킬 수 있다.

name: (Ghost) Revenant

description.value:
The ghost possesses and transforms an adjacent corpse (this requires 2 actions if the ghost is possessing its own corpse; otherwise, it takes an hour).

The possessed corpse uses the statistics of a non-incorporeal undead 2 levels lower than the ghost, and the ghost possesses it as if using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} spell. The specific undead is determined by the nature of the ghost and the corpse-@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghouls}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{Wights}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.GNwLVbfFx8EPz7xO]{Dullahans} are all common, but almost any undead is possible.

If the ghost ceases to possess the corpse, the corporeal undead is immediately destroyed.

빙의된 시체는 유령보다 2레벨 낮은 비무형 언데드의 수치를 사용하며, 유령은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{빙의} 주문을 사용하는 것처럼 그것을 빙의한다. 구체적인 언데드는 유령과 시체의 성격에 따라 결정되는데, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{구울}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{와이트}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.GNwLVbfFx8EPz7xO]{둘라한}이 모두 흔하지만, 거의 모든 언데드가 가능하다.

name: (Clockwork Creature) Wind-Up

description.value:
24 hours, [[/act disable-device dc=0]], standby

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

_desc_ko:
24시간, [[/act disable-device dc=0]], 대기

태엽 장치가 작동하려면, 다른 생물이 고유한 열쇠로 태엽을 감아야 한다. 이는 1분이 걸린다. 일단 태엽이 감기면, 명시된 시간 동안(대개 24시간) 작동 상태를 유지하며, 그 시간이 지나면 주변을 인지하지 못하게 되고 다시 태엽을 감을 때까지 행동할 수 없다. 일부 태엽 장치의 능력은 남은 작동 시간의 일부를 소비할 것을 요구한다. 그들은 가진 것보다 더 많이 소비할 수 없으며 남은 시간이 0이 되는 즉시 정지한다. 태엽 장치가 마지막으로 언제 감겼는지 불분명하다면, 대부분의 태엽 관리자는 정해진 시간(대개 오전 8시)에 모든 태엽 장치를 감는다.

태엽 감기 항목에 대기가 기재된 태엽 장치는 3행동 활동으로 대기 모드에 들어갈 수 있다. 대기 중에는 작동 시간이 감소하지 않지만, 주변을 감지할 수 있다(지각에 -2 페널티). 한 가지 예외를 제외하고는 행동할 수 없다: 생물을 인지하면, 반응으로 대기에서 벗어날 수 있다(적절하다면 우선권 굴림).

생물은 장치 무력화를 시도해 태엽 장치의 태엽을 풀 수 있다(태엽 감기 항목에 기재된 DC). 성공할 때마다, 태엽 장치는 작동 시간 1시간을 잃는다. 이는 태엽 장치가 대기 모드에 있어도 할 수 있다.

They can perceive living creatures normally with either darkvision or breathsense, and they can take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{Drop Prone} action.
_desc_ko: 강시는 더 이상 호흡감각으로만 살아 있는 생물을 보는 것에 제한되지 않으며, 더 이상 혐오 취약성을 지니지 않는다. 암시나 호흡감각 중 하나로 살아 있는 생물을 정상적으로 인지할 수 있으며, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{엎드리기} 행동을 취할 수 있다.

name: (Cryptid, Experimental) Operational Flaw

description.value: An experimental cryptid has a flaw in its construction that can be identified with a successful Perception check to [[/act seek]] against the hard DC of the creature's level. An experimental cryptid has weakness equal to its level to the attacks of any creature that has successfully located the experiment's operational flaw.

_desc_en: An experimental cryptid has a flaw in its construction that can be identified with a successful Perception check to [[/act seek]] against the hard DC of the creature's level. An experimental cryptid has weakness equal to its level to the attacks of any creature that has successfully located the experiment's operational flaw.
_desc_ko: 실험체 크립티드는 그 생물 레벨의 어려운 DC에 대해 [[/act seek]] 지각 판정에 성공하면 식별할 수 있는 제작상의 결함을 지니고 있다. 실험체 크립티드는 그 실험체의 작동 결함을 성공적으로 찾아낸 모든 생물의 공격에 대해 자신의 레벨과 같은 약점을 지닌다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Air of Sickness

description.value:
30 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:inflicts:sickened] save with a moderate DC for the nosferatu's level. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and takes a –2 status penalty to saves made to resist diseases and remove the sickened condition for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.XSXMGb5h4Um6YXiT]{Effect: Air of Sickness}

name: (Skeleton) Bone Storm

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect The skeleton transforms into a cyclone of bones, taking up the same space, but twice as tall. It then Strides up to double its Speed. It can move through spaces occupied by other creatures, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures the bone storm moves through take @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage for every 2 levels of the skeleton, with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic] save against the hard DC for the creature's level. A level 1 or lower skeleton only moves; it doesn't deal damage. A creature attempts this save only once even if the bone storm moved through its space multiple times. At the end of the movement, the skeleton reforms.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Effect The skeleton transforms into a cyclone of bones, taking up the same space, but twice as tall. It then Strides up to double its Speed. It can move through spaces occupied by other creatures, and this movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures the bone storm moves through take @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage for every 2 levels of the skeleton, with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic] save against the hard DC for the creature's level. A level 1 or lower skeleton only moves; it doesn't deal damage. A creature attempts this save only once even if the bone storm moved through its space multiple times. At the end of the movement, the skeleton reforms.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 한 번

효과 해골이 같은 공간을 차지하되 두 배로 높은 뼈의 회오리로 변한다. 그런 다음 이동속도의 최대 두 배까지 보폭한다. 다른 생물이 차지한 공간을 통과해 이동할 수 있으며, 이 이동은 반응을 유발하지 않는다. 뼈 폭풍이 통과한 생물은 해골의 2레벨마다 @Damage[1d6[slashing]] 피해를 받으며, 그 생물 레벨의 어려운 DC에 대해 @Check[reflex|dc:|basic] 내성을 굴린다. 1레벨 이하의 해골은 이동만 하며, 피해를 입히지 않는다. 뼈 폭풍이 여러 번 그 공간을 통과하더라도 생물은 이 내성을 한 번만 시도한다. 이동이 끝나면, 해골은 다시 형성된다.

name: (Blackfrost Dead) Ice Climb

description.value: The blackfrost dead can climb on ice as though it had the listed climb Speed. It ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.

_desc_en: The blackfrost dead can climb on ice as though it had the listed climb Speed. It ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.
_desc_ko: 흑상 망자는 명시된 등반 속도를 가진 것처럼 얼음 위를 등반할 수 있다. 얼음과 눈으로 인한 험지와 극심한 험지를 무시하며, 얼음을 건널 때 추락할 위험이 없다.

name: (Martial Artist, Dirty Fighting) Sand in Your Eye

description.value: The martial artist [[/act feint]]{Feints}. On a success, the martial artist tosses sand into the face of one target, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinding} them for 1 round or until the target Interacts to remove the blinded condition.

name_en: (Martial Artist, Dirty Fighting) Sand in Your Eye

_desc_ko: 무술가가 [[/act feint]]{기만 동작}을 한다. 성공하면 무술가는 한 대상의 얼굴에 모래를 뿌려 1라운드 동안 또는 대상이 눈멈 상태를 제거하기 위해 상호작용할 때까지 대상을 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{눈멈} 상태로 만든다.

name: (Lich) Void Shroud

description.value:
30 feet. The lich is surrounded by an aura of death, drawing forth souls to be consumed by the lich's constant hunger.

Living creatures in the emanation take a -2 status penalty to saves against fear and death effects. In addition, any creature that starts its turn in the area gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} condition unless it succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:] save against the lich's spell DC-4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.i3942RucZD9OHbAE]{Effect: Void Shroud}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.i3942RucZD9OHbAE]{Effect: Void Shroud}
_desc_ko:
30피트. 리치는 죽음의 오라에 둘러싸여, 리치의 끊임없는 굶주림에 소모될 영혼들을 끌어당긴다.

발산 범위 안의 살아있는 생물은 공포 및 죽음 효과에 대한 내성 굴림에 -2 상태 페널티를 받는다. 또한 이 범위 안에서 자기 턴을 시작하는 생물은 리치의 주문 DC-4에 대한 @Check[will|dc:] 내성에 성공하지 못하는 한 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{파멸 1} 상태를 얻는다.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.i3942RucZD9OHbAE]{효과: 공허의 장막}

name: (Spring-Heeled Jack) Resonant Terror

description.value: Spring-Heeled Jack glares at a creature he can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a @Check[will|options:inflicts:frightened] save (DC equal to the DC of Jack's Breath Weapon) or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure), and it can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 for 24 hours or until this curse is removed. After attempting its save, the creature is temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en: Spring-Heeled Jack glares at a creature he can see within 30 feet. name: (Blackfrost Dead) Blackfrost Breath

description.value: The blackfrost dead gasps sharply, then exhales a mist of dark-blue blackfrost particles in a @Template[emanation|distance:5]. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. The mist persists for 1 minute. A creature that ends its turn in the mist is exposed to blackfrost. The blackfrost dead can't use Blackfrost Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Blackfrost Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

_desc_en: The blackfrost dead gasps sharply, then exhales a mist of dark-blue blackfrost particles in a @Template[emanation|distance:5]. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. The mist persists for 1 minute. A creature that ends its turn in the mist is exposed to blackfrost. The blackfrost dead can't use Blackfrost Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Blackfrost Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.
_desc_ko: 흑상 망자가 날카롭게 숨을 들이켠 뒤, @Template[emanation|distance:5]로 짙은 청색 흑상 입자의 안개를 내뿜는다. 안개 안의 모든 생물은 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{은폐} 상태가 되고, 안개 밖의 모든 생물은 안개 안의 생물에게 은폐된다. 안개는 1분간 지속된다. 안개 안에서 자기 턴을 끝내는 생물은 흑상에 노출된다. 흑상 망자는 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Blackfrost Breath]]{1d4 라운드} 동안 흑상 브레스를 다시 사용할 수 없다.

name: (Vampire, Vetalarana, Manipulator) Paralyzing Claws

description.value: Any living creature hit by a vetalarana manipulator's claw Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. The target can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save. Use the moderate DC for the creature's level.

_desc_en: Any living creature hit by a vetalarana manipulator's claw Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. The target can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save. Use the moderate DC for the creature's level.
_desc_ko: 베탈라라나 조종자의 발톱 타격에 명중당한 살아있는 생물은 @Check[fortitude|dc:] 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{마비} 상태가 된다. 대상은 자기 턴이 끝날 때마다 이 효과를 끝내기 위해 새로운 내성을 시도할 수 있으며, 그러한 내성마다 DC가 누적적으로 1씩 감소한다. 해당 생물 레벨의 보통 DC를 사용하라.
